Mctt.Core.Syntactic.System.Command

The Static Semantics of Commands

A command moves the global state: the filed units Θ and the stack Ξ of open frames. core_cmd_load loads the unit it names, if it is not filed yet, by running that unit's own commands from nothing, and merges the units that run filed into Θ; the chain of units whose loading is in progress is what rules a cycle out. core_cmd_open declares the names its items generate (items_gen, the relation the local opens of bodies share) as definitions, aliases and inductive aliases of the frame. A command runs filled (TypedElab): its literals, eliminators and accesses through terms are filled first; no other expansion comes first.
Resolution is lexical — a unit is named by its full path, and an import lists the names it binds — so elaborating a unit needs none of the units it imports, which are only loaded while it runs.

  (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, B at level 69, Rb at level 69, ch at level 69, lp at level 69, rd at level 69, tc at level 69, c at level 69, Θ' at level 69, Ξ' at level 69, B' at level 69, Rb' at level 69).

  (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, B at level 69, Rb at level 69, ch at level 69, lp at level 69, rd at level 69, tc at level 69, cs at level 69, Θ' at level 69, Ξ' at level 69, B' at level 69, Rb' at level 69).

The Stack

A frame is an unfinished unit or module, named by its (absolute) module path: parameters, and the members declared so far. A member's type and body are checked in the telescope of all the frames' parameters, gs_tele, and stored generalized over it.

Definition gs_path (Ξ : gstack) : qname :=
  match Ξ with
  | (mp, _, _) :: _ => mp
  | nil => q_abs nil nil
  end.

Definition gs_push (mp : qname) (Δ : ctx) (Ξ : gstack) : gstack := (mp, fk_module, gu_body Δ ⋄) :: Ξ.

The frame of the module of the declared member k of the group D at pq, opened at mp with the parameters Δ and no member yet.
Definition gs_push_ind (mp pq : qname) (k : nat) (D : ind_decl) (Δ : ctx) (Ξ : gstack) : gstack :=
  (mp, fk_ind pq k D, gu_body Δ ⋄) :: Ξ.

The frame of the module of the record type R at mp, opened with the record's own parameters Δ and then a value of it (record_self), and no member yet.
Definition gs_push_record (mp : qname) (R : record_decl) (Δ : ctx) (Ξ : gstack) : gstack :=
  (mp, fk_record R, gu_body (ce_ass (sort_exp_kind (record_sort R)) (record_self mp R) :: Δ) ⋄) :: Ξ.

Definition gs_add (x : string) (E : gentry) (Ξ : gstack) : gstack :=
  match Ξ with
  | (mp, K, U) :: Ξ' => (mp, K, gu_body (gu_params U) (gu_mod U ⊳ x ↦ E)) :: Ξ'
  | nil => nil
  end.

Definition gs_fresh (x : string) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
  match Ξ with
  | (_, _, U) :: _ => gm_fresh x (gu_mod U)
  | nil => False
  end.

A definition and an axiom as they are filed: closed over the frames' parameters, at the kind κ of the sort of their type, which the command carries (the fill writes it, from the sort the type infers): a proposition is filed closed by ∀s (ctx_pi_at).
Definition gs_def (b pv : bool) (κ : abs_kind) (Ξ : gstack) (A M : exp) : gentry :=
  ge_def b pv κ (ctx_pi_at κ (gs_tele Ξ) A) (Some (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ) M)).

An axiom as it is filed: as a definition, without a body.
Definition gs_axiom (b pv : bool) (κ : abs_kind) (Ξ : gstack) (A : exp) : gentry :=
  ge_def b pv κ (ctx_pi_at κ (gs_tele Ξ) A) None.

A definition with a module part as it is filed, declared with the parameters Δ over the frames': its term part M of type A, both over Δ and the frames' parameters, closed over them; its module part the alias of H over them.
Definition dm_entry (Ξ : gstack) (pv : bool) (Δ : ctx) (A M : exp) (H : modexp) : gentry :=
  ge_def_mod pv (ctx_pi (gs_tele Ξ) (ctx_pi Δ A)) (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ) (ctx_fn Δ M)) (gu_mk (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias H)).

The type-former checks of the alias commands, ind_former and record_former, are in Fill, which a local alias's fill premises too.

Opens

The definitions and aliases an open generates (items_gen), declared in the frame in order, with the premises of run_cmd_def and run_cmd_alias: what the import references is checked once, as written (run_cmds_written), and a generated type is not written, so nothing here checks privacy.
gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ': declaring the generated items gs in order in the frame Ξ gives Ξ'.
Inductive gens_run (Θ : gdeps) : gstack -> list generated_item -> gstack -> Prop :=
No item leaves the frame as it is
| gens_run_nil : forall Ξ, gens_run Θ Ξ nil Ξ
A generated definition, checked at its type as run_cmd_def does
| gens_run_def : forall Ξ d pv r A M (i : nat) gs Ξ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters (gs_tele Ξ)) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A -> gs_fresh d Ξ ->
    gens_run Θ (gs_add d (gs_def true pv r Ξ A M) Ξ) gs Ξ' ->
    gens_run Θ Ξ (generated_item_def d pv r A M :: gs) Ξ'
A generated module alias, its target checked as run_cmd_alias does
| gens_run_alias : forall Ξ d pv E gs Ξ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E -> levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (gs_tele Ξ) E ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) E -> gs_fresh d Ξ ->
    gens_run Θ (gs_add d (ge_mod pv (gu_mk (gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias E))) Ξ) gs Ξ' ->
    gens_run Θ Ξ (generated_item_alias d pv E :: gs) Ξ'
A generated definition with a module part: its term M at the type inferred for it, W, and its module the alias of E. The typing of M at W follows from its inference (alg_type_infer_sound); it is a premise only because the well-formedness of a run is proved before that lemma, in the order of the files. The type A the item carries, read off the member type, is not used: a global open files at the inferred one, as before local opens generated such items. The inferred type is a type of a large universe, as a definition with a module part is relevant; that is a premise for the same reason.
| gens_run_def_mod : forall Ξ d pv A M E W (i : nat) gs Ξ',
    @alg_type_infer (gc_mk Θ Ξ) (gs_tele Ξ) W M ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ nf_to_exp W : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : nf_to_exp W ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E -> levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (gs_tele Ξ) E ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) E -> gs_fresh d Ξ ->
    gens_run Θ (gs_add d (dm_entry Ξ pv nil (nf_to_exp W) M E) Ξ) gs Ξ' ->
    gens_run Θ Ξ (generated_item_def_mod d pv A M E :: gs) Ξ'.

Groups of Inductive Declarations

A group is filed as one entry per declared member, in order (ge_ind): the group, with the parameters of the frames as its outermost uniform parameters, and the body of the member's module. The module is filled by generated commands (ind_mod_cmds), run in its frame as the commands of a module body are, and checked by the ordinary module judgment (wf_gentry_ind_body). As a term, the path of a member's entry is its type former (wf_mem_glob_ind); the group is named by the path of its first member.
The path of the declared type x a declaration makes.
Definition ind_qname (Ξ : gstack) (x : string) : qname := qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x.

The recursor of the only member M of the filed group D at pq, over the module's parameters (the uniform ones): at a finite level u, a motive P : Π Δn. Π (z : X us ns). Type⟨u⟩, one branch per constructor, of the type the eliminator gives a branch at the motive P, then Π Δn. Π (z : X us ns). P ns z. It is the eliminator, at that motive, of branches that are the branch arguments applied to what they bind. Below k binders past P, the motive is P under Δn and z, and the uniform parameters are the module's.
Definition rec_motive (M : imember) (k : nat) : exp :=
  apps (a_var (S (im_nn M) + k)) (vars_from 0 (S (im_nn M))).

Definition rec_uvars (D : ind_decl) (k : nat) : list exp := vars_from (2 + k) (ind_nu D).

The branch types, outermost first, the k-th under k before it.
Fixpoint rec_branch_types (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (M : imember) (k : nat) (cs : list (string * list carg)) : list centry :=
  match cs with
  | nil => nil
  | (c, gs) :: cs' =>
      ce_ass ak_relevant (ctx_pi (elim_bctx ak_relevant pq D M gs (rec_motive M k :: nil) (rec_uvars D k))
                (elim_branch_type pq D 0 M c gs (rec_motive M k) (rec_uvars D k)))
      :: rec_branch_types pq D M (S k) cs'
  end.

The level, the motive and the branches, innermost first.
Definition rec_tele (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (M : imember) : ctx :=
  List.rev (rec_branch_types pq D M 0 (im_cons M)) ++
  ce_ass ak_relevant (ctx_pi (elim_mctx pq D 0 M (vars_from 1 (ind_nu D))) (a_univ (a_var (S (im_nn M))))) ::
  ce_ass ak_level (a_level 0) :: nil.

The type of the recursor: over its level, motive and branches, a function from the member's parameters and a scrutinee to the motive.
Definition rec_ty (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (M : imember) : typ :=
  let K := List.length (im_cons M) in
  ctx_pi (rec_tele pq D M) (ctx_pi (elim_mctx pq D 0 M (rec_uvars D K)) (rec_motive M K)).

The branches of the eliminator, each the j-th branch argument applied to the variables the branch binds.
Fixpoint rec_brs (D : ind_decl) (M : imember) (K j : nat) (cs : list (string * list carg)) : list (string * nat * exp) :=
  match cs with
  | nil => nil
  | (c, gs) :: cs' =>
      let n := (im_nn M + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat in
      (c, n, apps (a_var (n + S (im_nn M) + (K - 1 - j))) (vars_from 0 n)) :: rec_brs D M K (S j) cs'
  end.

The recursor itself, of type rec_ty: the eliminator at the motive argument, of the branches rec_brs, on the scrutinee.
Definition rec_fn (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (M : imember) : exp :=
  let K := List.length (im_cons M) in
  ctx_fn (rec_tele pq D M)
    (ctx_fn (elim_mctx pq D 0 M (rec_uvars D K))
       (a_elim ak_relevant pq (rec_uvars D (K + S (im_nn M))) 0
          (eb_mk (S (im_nn M)) (member_scrutinee_type pq D 0 M (rec_uvars D (K + S (im_nn M))))
             (rec_motive M (K + S (im_nn M))) (rec_brs D M K 0 (im_cons M)) :: nil)
          (a_var 0))).

A group has a recursor when it has one member with a block: one declared member, no view, and any number of record views, which have no block of their own.
Definition ind_has_rec (D : ind_decl) : bool := Nat.eqb (ind_nblk D) 1.

The Recursor Module of a Group

Every group files a recursor module Rec, checked as any module is: a group declared by mutual T where in T's frame after its members (rec_cmds), any other in the module of its first declared member (ind_recursor_cmds). Its parameters, innermost first: one case per constructor of each member with a block (ind_block_members), in member order; one motive per such member, P_i : Π (nps_i) (z : M_i Us nps_i). Type@{u}; the level u; the group's own uniform parameters. It has one function per such member, rec_<member>, of type Π (nps_j) (z : M_j Us nps_j). P_j nps_j z, the eliminator of the group at the member, at the motives, its branches the cases at what they bind. The record views, which come last, have no block, so no motive, case or function: the eliminator gives a recursive argument at a record view the results of its fields' leaf paths, at the motives of the members they end in. A declared member is named by its own name, a view by its instance: the container member's name, then the names of the members its arguments are headed by, joined by _; a name met again gets _2, _3, ….
The motive of the member i, Mi, of a group of N members with a block, under k binders past the motives and its own S (im_nn Mi) binders.
Definition recursor_motive (N i : nat) (Mi : imember) (k : nat) : exp :=
  apps (a_var (S (im_nn Mi) + k + (N - 1 - i))) (vars_from 0 (S (im_nn Mi))).

The group's uniform parameters, under k binders past the N motives and the level.
Definition recursor_uvars (D : ind_decl) (N k : nat) : list exp := vars_from (k + N + 1) (ind_nu D).

The motives of all members with a block, under k binders past the motives.
Definition recursor_motives (D : ind_decl) (k : nat) : list exp :=
  List.map (fun iM => recursor_motive (ind_nblk D) (fst iM) (snd iM) k)
    (List.combine (List.seq 0 (ind_nblk D)) (ind_block_members D)).

The motives' types, outermost first: the member i's under the i motives before it and the level, for each member with a block.
Definition recursor_motive_tys (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) : list centry :=
  List.map (fun iM => ce_ass ak_relevant (ctx_pi (elim_mctx pq D (fst iM) (snd iM) (vars_from (S (fst iM)) (ind_nu D)))
                                     (a_univ (a_var (S (im_nn (snd iM)) + fst iM)))))
    (List.combine (List.seq 0 (ind_nblk D)) (ind_block_members D)).

The cases' types, outermost first, from the member i on, k cases before: the case of the constructor c of Mi, of the motive of Mi at the constructor, under the binders of a branch for it. Run on the members with a block.
Fixpoint recursor_case_tys (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (i k : nat) (ms : list imember) : list centry :=
  match ms with
  | nil => nil
  | Mi :: ms' =>
      let N := ind_nblk D in
      (fix cases (k : nat) (cs : list (string * list carg)) : list centry :=
         match cs with
         | nil => nil
         | (c, gs) :: cs' =>
             ce_ass ak_relevant (ctx_pi (elim_bctx ak_relevant pq D Mi gs (recursor_motives D k) (recursor_uvars D N k))
                       (elim_branch_type pq D i Mi c gs (recursor_motive N i Mi k) (recursor_uvars D N k)))
             :: cases (S k) cs'
         end) k (im_cons Mi)
      ++ recursor_case_tys pq D (S i) (k + List.length (im_cons Mi)) ms'
  end.

The number of cases of a group: of its members with a block.
Definition recursor_ncases (D : ind_decl) : nat := List.fold_right (fun Mi n => List.length (im_cons Mi) + n) 0 (ind_block_members D).

The parameters of the module, innermost first, over the frames' parameters, the group's own uniform parameters Δu outermost.
Definition recursor_tele (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (Δu : ctx) : ctx :=
  List.rev (recursor_case_tys pq D 0 0 (ind_block_members D)) ++ List.rev (recursor_motive_tys pq D) ++ ce_ass ak_level (a_level 0) :: Δu.

The branches of the block of the member Mi, whose cases start at kc, in the function of a member of nj binders: each the case applied to what the branch binds.
Fixpoint recursor_brs (D : ind_decl) (K nj kc : nat) (Mi : imember) (cs : list (string * list carg)) : list (string * nat * exp) :=
  match cs with
  | nil => nil
  | (c, gs) :: cs' =>
      let n := (im_nn Mi + List.length gs + cargs_nrec D gs)%nat in
      (c, n, apps (a_var (n + nj + (K - 1 - kc))) (vars_from 0 n)) :: recursor_brs D K nj (S kc) Mi cs'
  end.

The blocks of the eliminator of the group D at pq in the function of a member of nj binders, from the member i on, kc cases before. Run on the members with a block.
Fixpoint recursor_blocks (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (K nj i kc : nat) (ms : list imember) : list eblock :=
  match ms with
  | nil => nil
  | Mi :: ms' =>
      eb_mk (S (im_nn Mi)) (member_scrutinee_type pq D i Mi (recursor_uvars D (ind_nblk D) (K + nj)))
        (recursor_motive (ind_nblk D) i Mi (K + nj))
        (recursor_brs D K nj kc Mi (im_cons Mi))
      :: recursor_blocks pq D K nj (S i) (kc + List.length (im_cons Mi)) ms'
  end.

The function of the member j, Mj, with a block: its type and its body.
Definition recursor_fn_ty (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (j : nat) (Mj : imember) : typ :=
  let N := ind_nblk D in
  let K := recursor_ncases D in
  ctx_pi (elim_mctx pq D j Mj (recursor_uvars D N K)) (recursor_motive N j Mj K).

Definition recursor_fn (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (j : nat) (Mj : imember) : exp :=
  let N := ind_nblk D in
  let K := recursor_ncases D in
  ctx_fn (elim_mctx pq D j Mj (recursor_uvars D N K))
    (a_elim ak_relevant pq (recursor_uvars D N (K + S (im_nn Mj))) j
       (recursor_blocks pq D K (S (im_nn Mj)) 0 0 (ind_block_members D)) (a_var 0)).

The last name of a path.
Definition qname_last (p : qname) : string := List.last (q_chain p) EmptyString.

The name of the declared member j of the group filed at p.
Definition member_name (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (p : qname) (j : nat) : string :=
  match ind_lookup Θ Ξ p with
  | Some D => match ind_mpath D j with Some pm => qname_last pm | None => EmptyString end
  | None => EmptyString
  end.

The names of the members heading the arguments of an instance, each after _.
Definition inst_member_names (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Is : list exp) : string :=
  String.concat EmptyString
    (List.map (fun I => match app_head I with
                        | a_ind p j => ("_" ++ member_name Θ Ξ p j)%string
                        | _ => EmptyString
                        end) Is).

The name of a member: a declared one's own, a view's and a record view's from its container member's or record's name and its instance.
Definition recursor_member_name (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Mi : imember) : string :=
  match im_head Mi with
  | mh_decl pm => qname_last pm
  | mh_view qc k Is _ => (member_name Θ Ξ qc k ++ inst_member_names Θ Ξ Is)%string
  | mh_record qr Is _ => (qname_last qr ++ inst_member_names Θ Ξ Is)%string
  end.

A decimal numeral, as written.
Fixpoint uint_string (d : Decimal.uint) : string :=
  match d with
  | Decimal.Nil => EmptyString
  | Decimal.D0 d' => "0" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D1 d' => "1" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D2 d' => "2" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D3 d' => "3" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D4 d' => "4" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D5 d' => "5" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D6 d' => "6" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D7 d' => "7" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D8 d' => "8" ++ uint_string d'
  | Decimal.D9 d' => "9" ++ uint_string d'
  end%string.

The names xs, each met again after seen given the first suffix _2, _3, … that makes it new. The candidates x, x_2, …, x_(|seen|+1) are |seen| + 1 distinct names, so by pigeonhole one of them is not in seen: trying them in order, the last is returned unchecked, and it is new when all before it are taken. The bound is structural, not fuel: the search never runs out, and a name that were not new would only make the module's run_cmd_def reject it as not fresh.
Fixpoint recursor_fresh_names (seen : list string) (xs : list string) : list string :=
  match xs with
  | nil => nil
  | x :: xs' =>
      let pick := (fix try (n : nat) (m : nat) : string :=
                     let cand := match n with 0 => x | _ => (x ++ "_" ++ uint_string (Nat.to_uint (S n)))%string end in
                     match m with
                     | 0 => cand
                     | S m' => if List.existsb (String.eqb cand) seen then try (S n) m' else cand
                     end) 0 (List.length seen) in
      pick :: recursor_fresh_names (seen ++ pick :: nil) xs'
  end.

The functions' names, rec_ then the members' with a block.
Definition recursor_names (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (D : ind_decl) : list string :=
  List.map (fun x => ("rec_" ++ x)%string) (recursor_fresh_names nil (List.map (recursor_member_name Θ Ξ) (ind_block_members D))).

The command that files the recursor module Rec of the group D at pq, its names read at Θ ⍮ Ξ, with Δu the uniform parameters its own parameters end in: the group's own ones in the frame the members are filed in, none in the module of a member, whose frame binds them. The module's frame is opened, its definitions run in it, and it is closed; all are core commands, generated, not written.
Definition recursor_mod_cmds (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (Δu : ctx) : list core_cmd :=
  core_cmd_mod_open "Rec" false (recursor_tele pq D Δu) ::
    List.map (fun jx => let '(j, Mj, x) := jx in core_cmd_def x true false ak_relevant (recursor_fn_ty pq D j Mj) (Some (recursor_fn pq D j Mj)))
       (List.combine (List.combine (List.seq 0 (ind_nblk D)) (ind_block_members D)) (recursor_names Θ Ξ D)) ++
    core_cmd_close "Rec" false :: nil.

The commands that file the recursor module of the group D at pq, declared as R, after its members, at the stack Ξ they are filed in: none unless R asks for it.
Definition rec_cmds (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) : list core_cmd :=
  if raw_decl_rec_field R then recursor_mod_cmds Θ Ξ pq D (raw_decl_uparams R) else nil.

The Module of a Declared Member

The module of the declared member k, M, of the group D at pq is filled by commands run in its frame, whose parameters are the group's uniform ones, as the commands of a module body are: one transparent public definition per constructor, the constructor at the module's parameters (ind_con_cmd); the recursor rec of a group of one member and no view; and, in the first declared member's module of a group not declared by mutual T where, the recursor module Rec, whose parameters are those of recursor_tele without the uniform ones, which the frame binds already (ind_mod_cmds).
The definition of the constructor c of arguments gs: its type over the member's non-uniform parameters and its arguments, its term the constructor at the module's parameters; generated.
Definition ind_con_cmd (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (k : nat) (M : imember) (cg : (string * list carg)%type) : core_cmd :=
  core_cmd_def (fst cg) true false ak_relevant
    (ctx_pi (im_nparams M) (ctx_pi (cargs_ctx pq D M (snd cg)) (apps (a_ind pq k) (ind_pvars D M (List.length (snd cg))))))
    (Some (apps (a_con pq k (fst cg)) (vars_from 0 (ind_nu D)))).

The recursor rec, when the group has one; generated.
Definition ind_rec_cmds (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (M : imember) : list core_cmd :=
  if ind_has_rec D then core_cmd_def "rec" true false ak_relevant (rec_ty pq D M) (Some (rec_fn pq D M)) :: nil else nil.

The recursor module Rec, in the first declared member's module of a group not declared by mutual T where.
Definition ind_recursor_cmds (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (k : nat) : list core_cmd :=
  if Nat.eqb k 0 && negb (raw_decl_rec_field R) then recursor_mod_cmds Θ Ξ pq D nil else nil.

The commands of the module of the declared member k, M: its constructors, the recursor, and the recursor module, in that order; the names of Rec's functions are read at Θ ⍮ Ξ, the stack the commands run in: the member's frame, through which the group is found.
Definition ind_mod_cmds (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (k : nat) (M : imember) :
    list core_cmd :=
  List.map (ind_con_cmd pq D k M) (im_cons M) ++ ind_rec_cmds pq D M ++ ind_recursor_cmds Θ Ξ R pq D k.

The names a group declared as R at the stack Ξ, filed as D, generates are left free by its own: rec and Rec name no constructor of the module they are filed in, and the recursor module of a mutual T group is fresh in T's frame.
Record gen_names_free (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) (D : ind_decl) : Prop := mk_gen_names_free
  {
The recursor rec of a one-member group is no constructor of it
    rec_not_constructor : ind_has_rec D = true -> forall M, ind_member D 0 = Some M ->
      ~ In "rec"%string (List.map fst (im_cons M))
    
The recursor module Rec in the first member's module is no constructor of it
  ; rec_module_not_constructor : raw_decl_rec_field R = false -> forall M, ind_member D 0 = Some M ->
      ~ In "Rec"%string (List.map fst (im_cons M))
    
The recursor module of a mutual T group is no member of it
  ; mutual_rec_not_member : raw_decl_rec_field R = true -> ~ In "Rec"%string (List.map raw_member_name (raw_decl_members R))
    
nor declared in T's frame before it
  ; mutual_rec_fresh : raw_decl_rec_field R = true -> gs_fresh "Rec"%string Ξ }.

Classifying the Arguments

Each argument of each constructor of each declared member is a type in the context it is written in: the arguments before it, the member's parameters, the variables Self_0, …, Self_(n-1) of the declared members (raw_decl_selfs, Self_0 outermost), the frames' parameters. It is classified (classify_arg) as written when that finds it free or recursive in a declared member, and as its normal form otherwise: so Arr Ord, with Arr X := ℕ → X, is classified as ℕ → Ord is, and a nested occurrence is found on normal forms only. An instance met is keyed by its arguments normalized (view_inst_key); two keys are of one view exactly when they are equal up to their proofs (view_key_eq), and a view's key is its first instance met. The classification is a function of the argument.
The contexts a group's parts are written in (raw_decl_selfs, raw_member_args_ctx, raw_args_tele) are in Translations.
The number of uniform parameters of the filed group at qc, if k is one of its declared members.
Definition grp_info (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (qc : qname) (k : nat) : option nat :=
  match ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc with
  | Some D' => if k <? ind_ndecl D' then Some (ind_nu D') else None
  | None => None
  end.

The number of parameters of the record at qr, if it is one.
Definition rec_info (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (qr : qname) : option nat :=
  option_map (fun R => List.length (record_params R)) (record_lookup Θ Ξ qr).

nbes Θ Ξ Γ Ms As Ws: the terms Ms normalize pointwise at the types As to Ws, all in Γ.
Inductive nbes (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : list exp -> list typ -> list nf -> Prop :=
No term
| nbes_nil : nbes Θ Ξ Γ nil nil nil
The first term, typed at its type first, as normalizing an untyped term need not terminate, then the rest
| nbes_cons : forall M Ms A As W Ws,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> nbe Θ Ξ Γ M A W -> nbes Θ Ξ Γ Ms As Ws -> nbes Θ Ξ Γ (M :: Ms) (A :: As) (W :: Ws).

view_inst_key Θ Ξ Γ x y: the instance x a classification reads, its arguments terms in Γ, has the key y, its arguments normalized at the parameters' types of the container or the record.
Inductive view_inst_key (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : view_inst -> view_key -> Prop :=
The declared member k of the filed group at qc, at the uniform arguments Cs, normalized at the group's uniform parameters
| view_inst_key_inductive : forall qc k Cs D' Ws,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' ->
    nbes Θ Ξ Γ Cs (tele_insts (ind_uparams D') sb_id Cs) Ws ->
    view_inst_key Θ Ξ Γ (vi_ind qc k Cs) (vk_ind qc k Ws)
The record at qr, at the instance Is, normalized at the record's parameters
| view_inst_key_record : forall qr Is Rr Ws,
    record_lookup Θ Ξ qr = Some Rr ->
    nbes Θ Ξ Γ Is (tele_insts (record_params Rr) sb_id Is) Ws ->
    view_inst_key Θ Ξ Γ (vi_record qr Is) (vk_record qr Ws).

written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ t t': the shape t as classified has the instance it nests at, if any, keyed (view_inst_key) in Γ, and is otherwise t'.
Inductive written_ptyp_key (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : written_ptyp -> classified_ptyp -> Prop :=
A declared member: no instance
| written_ptyp_key_self : forall j Ps,
    written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ (classified_ptyp_self j Ps) (classified_ptyp_self j Ps)
A nested occurrence: its instance keyed
| written_ptyp_key_nest : forall x y Ns,
    view_inst_key Θ Ξ Γ x y ->
    written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ (classified_ptyp_nest x Ns) (classified_ptyp_nest y Ns)
A function: its shape keyed
| written_ptyp_key_pi : forall B t t',
    written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ t t' ->
    written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ (classified_ptyp_pi B t) (classified_ptyp_pi B t').

written_carg_key Θ Ξ Γ g g': the argument g as classified, its instance keyed in Γ, is g'.
Inductive written_carg_key (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : written_carg -> classified_carg -> Prop :=
A non-recursive argument: no instance
| written_carg_key_arg : forall κ A,
    written_carg_key Θ Ξ Γ (classified_carg_arg κ A) (classified_carg_arg κ A)
A recursive argument: its shape keyed
| written_carg_key_rec : forall t t',
    written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ t t' ->
    written_carg_key Θ Ξ Γ (classified_carg_rec_case t) (classified_carg_rec_case t').

An argument T in the context Γ, the arguments before it recursive as pat says, the np - nu non-uniform parameters under them. An instance it nests at is over the uniform parameters, the Selfs and the frames' parameters, the context Γ without the arguments before it and the non-uniform parameters; it is keyed there.
Inductive classify_arg_in (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (nu np n : nat) (pat : list bool) (T : exp) : classified_carg -> Prop :=
As written. The classification as written meets no instance (grp_none, rec_none).
| classify_in_syn : forall g g',
    classify_arg grp_none rec_none nu np n pat T = Some g ->
    written_carg_key Θ Ξ (List.skipn (List.length pat + (np - nu)) Γ) g g' ->
    classify_arg_in Θ Ξ Γ nu np n pat T g'
As its normal form, when not as written. The normal form holds no proof (nf_proof_free): an instance it nests at is strengthened past the arguments before it, which a kept proof (nf_proof) in it could have used.
| classify_in_nf : forall i W g g',
    classify_arg grp_none rec_none nu np n pat T = None ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ T : Typeω@i ->
    nbe_ty Θ Ξ Γ T W ->
    nf_proof_free W ->
    classify_arg (grp_info Θ Ξ) (rec_info Θ Ξ) nu np n pat (nf_to_exp W) = Some g ->
    written_carg_key Θ Ξ (List.skipn (List.length pat + (np - nu)) Γ) g g' ->
    classify_arg_in Θ Ξ Γ nu np n pat T g'.

classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n pat args1 args gs: the arguments args, after args1 (recursive as pat says), classify as gs, each in the context of those before it over Γp.
Inductive classify_args_in (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γp : ctx) (nu np n : nat) :
    list bool -> list (string * abs_kind * exp) -> list (string * abs_kind * exp) -> list classified_carg -> Prop :=
No argument left
| classify_args_in_nil : forall pat args1, classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n pat args1 nil nil
The next argument, classified, then the rest after it. A non-recursive one is tagged with the kind κ the argument carries (classified_carg_tag); the group's well-formedness checks it. A recursive argument is a type of the group, so it is tagged relevant: its filed entry drops the tag, which is checked here.
| classify_args_in_cons : forall pat args1 y κ T args g gs,
    classify_arg_in Θ Ξ (raw_args_tele args1 ++ Γp) nu np n pat T g ->
    (classified_carg_bit g = true -> κ = ak_relevant) ->
    classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n (classified_carg_bit g :: pat) (args1 ++ (y, κ, T) :: nil) args gs ->
    classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n pat args1 ((y, κ, T) :: args) (classified_carg_tag κ g :: gs).

The raw constructors rcs classify as cs, pointwise, keeping their names.
Definition classify_cons_in (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γp : ctx) (nu np n : nat)
    (rcs : list (string * list (string * abs_kind * exp))) (cs : list (string * list classified_carg)) : Prop :=
  Forall2 (fun rc c => fst rc = fst c /\ classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n nil nil (snd rc) (snd c)) rcs cs.

The constructors of a declared member.
Definition raw_member_classify (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) (Mr : raw_member) (cs : list (string * list classified_carg)) : Prop :=
  classify_cons_in Θ Ξ (raw_member_args_ctx Ξ R Mr) (raw_decl_nu R) (List.length (raw_member_nparams Mr) + raw_decl_nu R) (raw_decl_nmembers R) (raw_member_cons Mr) cs.

Lemma nbes_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ Ms As Ws Ws', nbes Θ Ξ Γ Ms As Ws -> nbes Θ Ξ Γ Ms As Ws' -> Ws = Ws'.
Proof.
  intros * H; revert Ws'; induction H; intros Ws' H'; inversion H'; subst; [ reflexivity |].
  f_equal; [ eapply functional_nbe; eassumption | auto ].
Qed.

Lemma view_inst_key_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ x y y', view_inst_key Θ Ξ Γ x y -> view_inst_key Θ Ξ Γ x y' -> y = y'.
Proof.
  intros * H H'; destruct H; inversion H'; subst.
  - match goal with H1 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _, H2 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
    f_equal; eapply nbes_functional; eassumption.
  - match goal with H1 : record_lookup _ _ ?qn = _, H2 : record_lookup _ _ ?qn = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
    f_equal; eapply nbes_functional; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma written_ptyp_key_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ t t1 t2, written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ t t1 -> written_ptyp_key Θ Ξ Γ t t2 -> t1 = t2.
Proof.
  intros * H; revert t2; induction H; intros t2 H'; inversion H'; subst; [ reflexivity | | ].
  - f_equal; eapply view_inst_key_functional; eassumption.
  - f_equal; auto.
Qed.

Lemma written_carg_key_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ g g1 g2, written_carg_key Θ Ξ Γ g g1 -> written_carg_key Θ Ξ Γ g g2 -> g1 = g2.
Proof.
  intros * H H'; destruct H; inversion H'; subst; [ reflexivity |].
  f_equal; eapply written_ptyp_key_functional; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma classify_arg_in_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ nu np n pat T g g',
    classify_arg_in Θ Ξ Γ nu np n pat T g -> classify_arg_in Θ Ξ Γ nu np n pat T g' -> g = g'.
Proof.
  intros * H H'; destruct H as [g0 g Hg Hk | i W g0 g Hn _ HW _ Hg Hk];
    inversion H' as [g0' g'' Hg' Hk' | i' W' g0' g'' Hn' _ HW' _ Hg' Hk']; subst; try congruence.
  - rewrite Hg in Hg'; injection Hg' as <-; exact (written_carg_key_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hk').
  - pose proof (functional_nbe_ty _ _ _ _ HW HW') as <-.
    rewrite Hg in Hg'; injection Hg' as <-; exact (written_carg_key_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hk').
Qed.

Lemma classify_args_in_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γp nu np n pat args1 args gs gs',
    classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n pat args1 args gs -> classify_args_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n pat args1 args gs' -> gs = gs'.
Proof.
  intros * H; revert gs'; induction H as [| pat args1 y κ T args g gs Hg _ Hgs IH]; intros gs' H'; inversion H'; subst;
    [ reflexivity |].
  match goal with Hg' : classify_arg_in _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?g' |- _ =>
    pose proof (classify_arg_in_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg Hg') as <- end.
  f_equal; apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma classify_cons_in_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γp nu np n rcs cs cs',
    classify_cons_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n rcs cs -> classify_cons_in Θ Ξ Γp nu np n rcs cs' -> cs = cs'.
Proof.
  unfold classify_cons_in; intros Θ Ξ Γp nu np n rcs.
  induction rcs as [| rc rcs IH]; intros * H H'; inversion H; inversion H'; subst; [ reflexivity |].
  destruct y as [c gs], y0 as [c' gs']; cbn in *; destruct_conjs; subst.
  f_equal; [ f_equal; eapply classify_args_in_functional; eassumption | apply IH; assumption ].
Qed.

The Views

A view is an instance (qc, k, Cs) met: the declared member k of the filed group at qc at the uniform arguments Cs, normal, over the group's own uniform parameters, the Selfs and the frames'. Its non-uniform parameters are the container's member's at Cs, normalized, and filed when they are free of the Selfs, without them (view_nparams): the group checks them against the container's at its Selfs, so they cannot mention the group. Its constructors are the container's member's, each argument the container's type at Cs, classified as a declared member's is (view_classify). Its siblings are the members of the container's group at Cs (siblings_from): a declared one at Cs, a view of it at its own uniform arguments at Cs, normalized.
The argument a context entry gives: an assumption gives its type, at its kind; any other entry gives none. The telescopes read so are of assumptions only (ctx_args).
Definition centry_arg (e : centry) : list (string * abs_kind * exp) :=
  match e with
  | ce_ass κ A => (""%string, κ, A) :: nil
  | ce_def _ _ | ce_dm _ _ _ | ce_mod _ => nil
  end.

A telescope, innermost first, as arguments, outermost first. The telescopes read so are of assumptions (cargs_ctx, record_fctx).
Definition ctx_args (Δ : ctx) : list (string * abs_kind * exp) := List.rev (List.flat_map centry_arg Δ).

The constructors of a view, classified. An inductive view (qc, k, Cs): the container's member's, each argument its type at Cs, classified as a declared member's is. A record view (qr, Is): one, rview_con, its arguments the record's fields at Is, each over those before it, classified as a declared member's arguments are.
Inductive view_classify (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) : view_key -> list (string * list classified_carg) -> Prop :=
An inductive view
| view_classify_inductive : forall qc k Cs D' Mk' cs,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' ->
    ind_member D' k = Some Mk' ->
    classify_cons_in Θ Ξ (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk') (sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs)) ++ raw_decl_uniform_ctx Ξ R) (raw_decl_nu R) (im_nn Mk' + raw_decl_nu R) (raw_decl_nmembers R)
      (List.map (fun cg => (fst cg, ctx_args (tele_sub (cargs_ctx qc D' Mk' (snd cg)) (sb_qn (im_nn Mk') (sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs))))))
         (im_cons Mk'))
      cs ->
    view_classify Θ Ξ R (vk_ind qc k Cs) cs
A record view
| view_classify_record : forall qr Is Rr cs,
    record_lookup Θ Ξ qr = Some Rr ->
    classify_cons_in Θ Ξ (raw_decl_uniform_ctx Ξ R) (raw_decl_nu R) (raw_decl_nu R) (raw_decl_nmembers R)
      ((rview_con, ctx_args (tele_sub (record_fctx Rr (List.length (record_fields Rr))) (sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Is)))) :: nil)
      cs ->
    view_classify Θ Ξ R (vk_record qr Is) cs.

A telescope of assumptions, innermost first, each normalized in the ones before it, over Γ, each at its kind.
Inductive nbe_tele (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
The empty telescope
| nbe_tele_nil : nbe_tele Θ Ξ Γ nil nil
The innermost assumption, normalized in the ones before it; it is a type of its kind there first, as normalizing an untyped term need not terminate
| nbe_tele_cons : forall κ A Δ W Δ',
    (exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort κ Typeω@i) ->
    nbe_ty Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) A W ->
    nbe_tele Θ Ξ Γ Δ Δ' ->
    nbe_tele Θ Ξ Γ (ce_ass κ A :: Δ) (ce_ass κ (nf_to_exp W) :: Δ').

The preimage of a telescope of assumptions under the pattern weakening pat, each entry under those before it, if it has one.
Fixpoint image_tele (pat : list bool) (Δ : ctx) : option ctx :=
  match Δ with
  | nil => Some nil
  | ce_ass κ A :: Δ' =>
      match image_pat (List.repeat false (List.length Δ') ++ pat) A, image_tele pat Δ' with
      | Some A0, Some Δ0 => Some (ce_ass κ A0 :: Δ0)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | _ :: _ => None
  end.

The non-uniform parameters of a view, filed. An inductive view's: the container's member's at Cs, normalized over the group's own uniform parameters, the Selfs and the frames', free of the Selfs and without them. A record view has none.
Inductive view_nparams (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) : view_key -> ctx -> Prop :=
An inductive view
| view_nparams_inductive : forall qc k Cs D' Mk' Ws Nv,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' ->
    ind_member D' k = Some Mk' ->
    nbe_tele Θ Ξ (raw_decl_uniform_ctx Ξ R) (tele_sub (im_nparams Mk') (sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs))) Ws ->
    image_tele (List.repeat false (raw_decl_nu R) ++ List.repeat true (raw_decl_nmembers R)) Ws = Some Nv ->
    view_nparams Θ Ξ R (vk_ind qc k Cs) Nv
A record view
| view_nparams_record : forall qr Is,
    view_nparams Θ Ξ R (vk_record qr Is) nil.

siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i ms ss: the members ms of the container's group at qc, from position i, at the uniform arguments Cs, are the views ss: the uniform arguments are a view's key's, normal.
Inductive siblings_from (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γc : ctx) (qc : qname) (Cs : list nf) :
    nat -> list imember -> list view_key -> Prop :=
No member left
| siblings_from_nil : forall i, siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i nil nil
A declared member: itself at Cs
| siblings_from_decl : forall i M ms ss pm,
    im_head M = mh_decl pm ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs (S i) ms ss ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i (M :: ms) (vk_ind qc i Cs :: ss)
A view of the container: the member it views, at its own uniform arguments at Cs, normalized
| siblings_from_view : forall i M ms ss qv kv Iv vmv Dv Ws,
    im_head M = mh_view qv kv Iv vmv ->
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ qv = Some Dv ->
    nbes Θ Ξ Γc (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs)]) Iv)
      (List.map (fun T => T[sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs)]) (tele_insts (ind_uparams Dv) sb_id Iv)) Ws ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs (S i) ms ss ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i (M :: ms) (vk_ind qv kv Ws :: ss)
A record view of the container: the record at its instance at Cs, normalized
| siblings_from_record : forall i M ms ss qr Ir fl Rr Ws,
    im_head M = mh_record qr Ir fl ->
    record_lookup Θ Ξ qr = Some Rr ->
    nbes Θ Ξ Γc (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs)]) Ir)
      (List.map (fun T => T[sb_of_list sb_id (List.map nf_to_exp Cs)]) (tele_insts (record_params Rr) sb_id Ir)) Ws ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs (S i) ms ss ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i (M :: ms) (vk_record qr Ws :: ss).

The siblings of a view (qc, k, Cs): the members of the container's group at Cs, over the group's own context.
Inductive view_siblings (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) : view_key -> list view_key -> Prop :=
An inductive view
| view_siblings_inductive : forall qc k Cs D' ss,
    ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' ->
    siblings_from Θ Ξ (raw_decl_uniform_ctx Ξ R) qc Cs 0 (ind_members D') ss ->
    view_siblings Θ Ξ R (vk_ind qc k Cs) ss
A record view: itself alone, its eliminator reading its fields
| view_siblings_record : forall qr Is,
    view_siblings Θ Ξ R (vk_record qr Is) (vk_record qr Is :: nil).

Filing the Group

The declared members, then the views, numbered in the order found; a view's uniform arguments with the Selfs instantiated (sb_selfs: Self_j is the type former of the member j at the frames' parameters), so that they are over the filed group's uniform parameters, the group's own and the frames'.
Under nu uniform parameters, Self_j for j < n becomes the type former of member j of the group at pq applied to the t frames' parameters.
Definition sb_selfs (pq : qname) (nu n t : nat) : sub :=
  sb_qn nu (sb_of_list sb_id (List.map (fun j => apps (a_ind pq j) (vars_from 0 t)) (List.seq 0 n))).

The declared members filed, each with its classified constructors numbered against the views filed Vs, if they all are.
Fixpoint raw_members_filed (Ξ : gstack) (n : nat) (Vs : list view_key) (ms : list raw_member)
    (css : list (list (string * list classified_carg))) : option (list imember) :=
  match ms, css with
  | nil, nil => Some nil
  | Mr :: ms', cs :: css' =>
      match classified_cons_num n Vs cs, raw_members_filed Ξ n Vs ms' css' with
      | Some cs', Some Ms => Some (mk_imember (mh_decl (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr))) (raw_member_nparams Mr) cs' :: Ms)
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | _, _ => None
  end.

A view x filed, at its position among the views filed Ks: an inductive view, its head with the uniform arguments instantiated by σ and its siblings numbered after the n declared members; a record view, its head with the instance instantiated by σ and the record's field names; then its filed non-uniform parameters Nv and its numbered constructors.
Definition raw_view_filed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (σ : sub) (n : nat) (Ks : list view_key) (x : view_key) (ss : list view_key)
    (cs : list (string * list classified_carg)) (Nv : ctx) : option imember :=
  match x with
  | vk_ind qc k Cs =>
      let Is := List.map (fun C => (nf_to_exp C)[σ]) Cs in
      match ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc with
      | Some D' =>
          match ind_member D' k, classified_cons_num n Ks cs with
          | Some _, Some cs' =>
              Some (mk_imember
                      (mh_view qc k Is (List.map (fun s => n + match view_key_index s Ks with Some v => v | None => 0 end) ss))
                      Nv cs')
          | _, _ => None
          end
      | None => None
      end
  | vk_record qr Cs =>
      match record_lookup Θ Ξ qr, classified_cons_num n Ks cs with
      | Some Rr, Some cs' =>
          Some (mk_imember (mh_record qr (List.map (fun C => (nf_to_exp C)[σ]) Cs) (List.map fst (record_fields Rr))) Nv cs')
      | _, _ => None
      end
  end.

The views filed, the keys xs in order, each with its data read off the tables aligned with the views found Vs, if they all are.
Fixpoint raw_views_filed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (σ : sub) (n : nat) (Ks xs Vs : list view_key) (Ss : list (list view_key))
    (css : list (list (string * list classified_carg))) (Nvs : list ctx) : option (list imember) :=
  match xs with
  | nil => Some nil
  | x :: xs' =>
      match view_key_pos x Vs with
      | Some v =>
          match raw_view_filed Θ Ξ σ n Ks x (List.nth v Ss nil) (List.nth v css nil) (List.nth v Nvs nil),
                raw_views_filed Θ Ξ σ n Ks xs' Vs Ss css Nvs with
          | Some M, Some Ms => Some (M :: Ms)
          | _, _ => None
          end
      | None => None
      end
  end.

The filed group: the declared members then the views, the inductive ones in the order found, then the record views by height (filed_keys), over the group's uniform parameters and the frames', at the first member's sort, the Selfs instantiated at the first member's path.
Definition raw_decl_filed (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (R : raw_decl) (Vs : list view_key) (Ss : list (list view_key))
    (csD csV : list (list (string * list classified_carg))) (Nvs : list ctx) : option ind_decl :=
  match raw_decl_members R with
  | Mr0 :: _ =>
      let σ := sb_selfs (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr0)) (raw_decl_nu R) (raw_decl_nmembers R) (List.length (gs_tele Ξ)) in
      let Ks := filed_keys (meets_table Vs csV) Vs in
      match raw_members_filed Ξ (raw_decl_nmembers R) Ks (raw_decl_members R) csD, raw_views_filed Θ Ξ σ (raw_decl_nmembers R) Ks Ks Vs Ss csV Nvs with
      | Some Ms, Some Mv => Some (mk_ind (raw_decl_uparams R ++ gs_tele Ξ) (raw_member_sort Mr0) (Ms ++ Mv))
      | _, _ => None
      end
  | nil => None
  end.

The Views' Instances with the Members as Variables

wf_gentry_ind_nil checks a group's views at their instances with the members as variables, IsS, linked to the filed instances Is by Is = map (fun I => I[grp_sb mp D]) (IsS k). The link does not determine IsS: grp_sb is not injective (Self_0 and the type former of the member 0 at the uniform parameters have one image), and no lemma rules out a typed IsS that mentions the group being declared, which is not filed yet. So the command fixes IsS: the filed instances with each type former of a declared member at the uniform parameters read back as that member's variable (exp_self_form), and checks the group at it (ind_nil_at), which gives the entry (ind_nil_at_entry).
self_var pq D d M: the variable Self_j, d binders above the Selfs, if M is the type former of the declared member j of the group at pq at the uniform parameters, d binders above them.
Definition self_var (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (d : nat) (M : exp) : option nat :=
  match app_head M with
  | a_ind pq' j =>
      if qname_eq_dec pq' pq then
        if (j <? ind_ndecl D) && (if list_eq_dec exp_eq_dec (app_args M) (vars_from d (ind_nu D)) then true else false)
        then Some (d + (ind_ndecl D - 1 - j))
        else None
      else None
  | _ => None
  end.

exp_self_form pq D d M: M, d binders above the uniform parameters of the group D at pq, with each type former of a declared member at the uniform parameters the member's variable (self_var), and every other variable of the uniform parameters moved past the Selfs, which grp_selfs_ctx D puts inside them. The instances are normal forms, which have no let and no module literal; those are left as they are.
Fixpoint exp_self_form (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (d : nat) (M : exp) {struct M} : exp :=
  match self_var pq D d M with
  | Some x => a_var x
  | None =>
      match M with
      | a_univ M' => a_univ (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | a_succl M' => a_succl (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | a_maxl M1 M2 => a_maxl (exp_self_form pq D d M1) (exp_self_form pq D d M2)
      | a_absurd A M' => a_absurd (exp_self_form pq D d A) (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | a_and P Q => a_and (exp_self_form pq D d P) (exp_self_form pq D (S d) Q)
      | a_conj P Q M1 M2 =>
          a_conj (exp_self_form pq D d P) (exp_self_form pq D (S d) Q) (exp_self_form pq D d M1) (exp_self_form pq D d M2)
      | a_left M' => a_left (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | a_right M' => a_right (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | a_elim r oq Us m Bks M' =>
          a_elim r oq (List.map (exp_self_form pq D d) Us) m
            ((fix blocks_self_form (Bks : list eblock) : list eblock :=
                match Bks with
                | nil => nil
                | eb_mk nm Z A Bs :: Bks' =>
                    eb_mk nm (exp_self_form pq D (nm - 1 + d) Z)
                      (exp_self_form pq D (nm + d) A)
                      (List.map (fun b => (fst b, exp_self_form pq D (snd (fst b) + d) (snd b))) Bs)
                    :: blocks_self_form Bks'
                end) Bks)
            (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | a_pi κd κc A B => a_pi κd κc (exp_self_form pq D d A) (exp_self_form pq D (S d) B)
      | a_fn A M' => a_fn (exp_self_form pq D d A) (exp_self_form pq D (S d) M')
      | a_app M1 M2 => a_app (exp_self_form pq D d M1) (exp_self_form pq D d M2)
      | a_var x => a_var (if x <? d then x else x + ind_ndecl D)
      | a_mem H x => a_mem (modexp_self_form pq D d H) x
      | a_tuple T fs => a_tuple (exp_self_form pq D d T) (List.map (fun f => (fst f, exp_self_form pq D d (snd f))) fs)
      | a_proj f M' => a_proj f (exp_self_form pq D d M')
      | _ => M
      end
  end
exp_self_form on module expressions: the module variables moved past the Selfs, the arguments read back.
with modexp_self_form (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (d : nat) (H : modexp) {struct H} : modexp :=
  match H with
  | me_var x => me_var (if x <? d then x else x + ind_ndecl D)
  | me_mem H' y => me_mem (modexp_self_form pq D d H') y
  | me_app H' N => me_app (modexp_self_form pq D d H') (exp_self_form pq D d N)
  | _ => H
  end.

The views' instances with the members as variables: at a view or a record view, its filed instance read back (exp_self_form).
Definition grp_self_insts (pq : qname) (D : ind_decl) (k : nat) : list exp :=
  match ind_member D k with
  | Some Mk =>
      match im_head Mk with
      | mh_view _ _ Is _ | mh_record _ Is _ => List.map (exp_self_form pq D 0) Is
      | mh_decl _ => nil
      end
  | None => nil
  end.

The premises of wf_gentry_ind_nil, at the views' instances with the members as variables IsS given, rather than any: the command checks the group at the instances it reads back (grp_self_insts).
Inductive ind_nil_at (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (D : ind_decl) (IsS : nat -> list exp) : Prop :=
The only rule: the premises of wf_gentry_ind_nil, IsS fixed
| mk_ind_nil_at : forall Δ M0 i n param_level param_sorts,
    ind_uparams D = Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ->
    all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) ->
    decl_mvc D ->
    List.length (gs_tele Ξ) <= ind_nu D ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ind_uparams D ->
    ind_order_ok D ->
    ind_member D 0 = Some M0 ->
    im_head M0 = mh_decl mp ->
    ind_sort_univ (ind_sort D) ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ind_uparams D ⊢ ind_sort D : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ind_uparams D ⊢ ind_sort_lvl (ind_sort D) : Level@n ->
    (forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> all_assumptions (im_nparams Mk)) ->
    (forall k Mk, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> List.NoDup (List.map fst (im_cons Mk))) ->
    (forall k Mk Δ1 κ T Δ2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_nparams Mk = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ ind_uparams D ⊢ T : (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (List.length Δ2)]ʷ) ->
    
The non-uniform parameters are of the sort, a universe
    (forall k Mk Δ1 κ T Δ2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_nparams Mk = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> κ = ak_relevant) ->
    (forall k Mk c gs gs1 r A gs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: gs2 ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk
         ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + im_nn Mk)]ʷ) ->
    
No argument of a type of levels
    (forall k Mk c gs gs1 r A gs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_arg r A :: gs2 ->
       carg_kind r) ->
    (forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 Bs1 B Bs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) ->
       gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> ptyp_doms t = Bs1 ++ B :: Bs2 ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ doms_ctx Bs1 ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk
         ⊢ B : (ind_sort D)[wk_shiftn (List.length Bs1 + List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + im_nn Mk)]ʷ) ->
    (forall k Mk c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) -> cargs_params_length D gs) ->
    (forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 Mj j P T, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> In (c, gs) (im_cons Mk) ->
       gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj ->
       nth_error (ptyp_ps t) j = Some P ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj)
                    (sb_of_wk (wk_shiftn (ptyp_depth t + List.length (cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1) + im_nn Mk))) (ptyp_ps t)) j
         = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ptyp_tele t ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ⊢ P : T) ->
    
the views
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       exists D' Mk', ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' /\ ind_member D' k' = Some Mk' /\ k' < ind_ndecl D' /\
         List.length Is = ind_nu D' /\ List.length vm = List.length (ind_members D') /\
         List.nth_error vm k' = Some k /\
         List.map fst (im_cons Mk) = List.map fst (im_cons Mk') /\
         (forall c gs' gs, ind_con Mk' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs -> cargs_correspond vm gs' gs)) ->
    
each view's instance Is is IsS with the members as variables
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       Is = List.map (fun I => I[grp_sb mp D]) (IsS k)) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' j I T, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> nth_error (IsS k) j = Some I ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D') Id (IsS k)) j = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ I : T) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v pm', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_decl pm' ->
       nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       exists Mv vm', ind_member D v = Some Mv /\ im_head Mv = mh_view qc i' Is vm') ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' k'' Is'' vm'', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_view q'' k'' Is'' vm'' ->
       nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       exists Mv X vm', ind_member D v = Some Mv /\ im_head Mv = mh_view q'' k'' X vm' /\
         List.length X = List.length Is'') ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' k'' Is'' vm'' D'' Mv X vm' j' C C' T,
       ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_view q'' k'' Is'' vm'' ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ q'' = Some D'' ->
       nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv -> im_head Mv = mh_view q'' k'' X vm' ->
       nth_error (IsS v) j' = Some C ->
       nth_error (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id (IsS k)]) Is'') j' = Some C' ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D'') Id Is'') j' = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ C ≈ C' : T[sb_of_list Id (IsS k)]) ->
    
the view equations
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       ind_member D v = Some Mv ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ˣ tele_wk (im_nparams Mv) (self_wk D 0) ≈ tele_sub (im_nparams Mi') (sb_of_list Id (IsS k))) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv c gs' gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       ind_member D v = Some Mv -> ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk (im_nparams Mv) (self_wk D 0) ++ grp_selfs_ctx D
         ⊢ˣ tele_sub (cargs_ctx qc D' Mi' gs') (sb_qn (im_nn Mv) (sb_of_list Id (IsS k))) ≈ self_cargs_ctx D IsS Mv gs) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv c gs' gs gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 d,
       ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       ind_member D v = Some Mv -> ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
       gs' = gs1' ++ ca_rec t' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> List.length gs1' = List.length gs1 ->
       d < ptyp_depth t ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn d (ptyp_doms t))) (self_wk D (List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv))
                 ++ self_cargs_ctx D IsS Mv gs1 ++ tele_wk (im_nparams Mv) (self_wk D 0) ++ grp_selfs_ctx D
         ⊢ (ptyp_dom_at (cargs_pat gs1') d t')[sb_qn (d + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv) (sb_of_list Id (IsS k))]
         ≈ (ptyp_dom_at (cargs_pat gs1) d t)[self_wk D (d + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv)]ʷ : Typeω@i) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv c gs' gs gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 Mj j P' P T,
       ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       ind_member D v = Some Mv -> ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
       gs' = gs1' ++ ca_rec t' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> List.length gs1' = List.length gs1 ->
       ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj ->
       nth_error (ptyp_ps_at (cargs_pat gs1') t') j = Some P' -> nth_error (ptyp_ps_at (cargs_pat gs1) t) j = Some P ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_list Id (ind_uvars D (im_nn Mv) (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1)))
                    (ptyp_ps_at (cargs_pat gs1) t)) j = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_doms t)) (self_wk D (List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv))
                 ++ self_cargs_ctx D IsS Mv gs1 ++ tele_wk (im_nparams Mv) (self_wk D 0) ++ grp_selfs_ctx D
         ⊢ P'[sb_qn (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv) (sb_of_list Id (IsS k))]
         : T[self_wk D (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv)]ʷ) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v Mv c gs' gs gs1' t' gs2' gs1 t gs2 Mj j P' P T,
       ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       ind_member D v = Some Mv -> ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
       gs' = gs1' ++ ca_rec t' :: gs2' -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> List.length gs1' = List.length gs1 ->
       ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj ->
       nth_error (ptyp_ps_at (cargs_pat gs1') t') j = Some P' -> nth_error (ptyp_ps_at (cargs_pat gs1) t) j = Some P ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (im_nparams Mj) (sb_of_list Id (ind_uvars D (im_nn Mv) (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1)))
                    (ptyp_ps_at (cargs_pat gs1) t)) j = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ tele_wk (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_doms t)) (self_wk D (List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv))
                 ++ self_cargs_ctx D IsS Mv gs1 ++ tele_wk (im_nparams Mv) (self_wk D 0) ++ grp_selfs_ctx D
         ⊢ P'[sb_qn (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv) (sb_of_list Id (IsS k))]
         ≈ P[self_wk D (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv)]ʷ
         : T[self_wk D (ptyp_depth t + List.length gs1 + im_nn Mv)]ʷ) ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ (ind_sort D')[sb_of_list Id (IsS k)] ⊆ (ind_sort D)[self_wk D 0]ʷ) ->
    
the record views: the facts without a judgment, the instances, their typing, the record view equations, the record's sort and the record view's type in the group's sort
    rview_struct_ok Θ Ξ D ->
    (forall k Mk qr Is fl, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
       Is = List.map (fun I => I[grp_sb mp D]) (IsS k)) ->
    (forall k Mk qr Is fl R j I T, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
       record_lookup Θ Ξ qr = Some R -> nth_error (IsS k) j = Some I ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (record_params R) Id (IsS k)) j = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ I : T) ->
    (forall k Mk qr Is fl R c gs, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
       record_lookup Θ Ξ qr = Some R -> im_cons Mk = (c, gs) :: nil ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ˣ tele_sub (record_fctx R (List.length (record_fields R))) (sb_of_list Id (IsS k))
                             ≈ self_cargs_ctx D IsS Mk gs) ->
    (forall k Mk qr Is fl R, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
       record_lookup Θ Ξ qr = Some R ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ (record_sort R)[sb_of_list Id (IsS k)] ⊆ (ind_sort D)[self_wk D 0]ʷ) ->
    (forall k Mk qr Is fl, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ apps_exp (a_record qr) (IsS k) : (ind_sort D)[self_wk D 0]ʷ) ->
    
a view's map takes its container's record views to record views of the same record, at instances equal to the container's at the view's instance
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' Is'' fl'', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_record q'' Is'' fl'' ->
       nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
       exists Mv X, ind_member D v = Some Mv /\ im_head Mv = mh_record q'' X fl'' /\ List.length X = List.length Is'') ->
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' Is'' fl'' R'' Mv X fl j' C C' T,
       ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' -> ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_record q'' Is'' fl'' ->
       record_lookup Θ Ξ q'' = Some R'' ->
       nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv -> im_head Mv = mh_record q'' X fl ->
       nth_error (IsS v) j' = Some C ->
       nth_error (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id (IsS k)]) Is'') j' = Some C' ->
       nth_error (tele_insts (record_params R'') Id Is'') j' = Some T ->
       Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ grp_selfs_ctx D ⊢ C ≈ C' : T[sb_of_list Id (IsS k)]) ->
    
the views' nesting is well founded
    (exists rk, view_rank_ok Θ Ξ D rk) ->
    
each view's members are those of the container's group
    (forall k Mk qc k' Is vm, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
       exists D', ind_lookup Θ Ξ qc = Some D' /\ view_wrap_ok D D' vm) ->
    
the views agree on their maps
    view_maps_coherent Θ Ξ D ->
    
the group's own uniform parameters are types of a universe or types of levels, not propositions: param_sorts gives their sorts
    (forall k, parameter_sort param_level (param_sorts k)) ->
    (forall Δ1 κ T Δ2, Δ = Δ1 ++ ce_ass κ T :: Δ2 -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ2 ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ T : param_sorts (List.length Δ2)) ->
    ind_nil_at Θ Ξ mp D IsS.

The group checked at the instances IsS is a well-formed entry.
Lemma ind_nil_at_entry : forall Θ Ξ mp D IsS, ind_nil_at Θ Ξ mp D IsS -> forall pv, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv mp 0 D ⋄.
Proof. intros * [] pv; eapply wf_gentry_ind_nil; eassumption. Qed.

Mutual Definitions

A mutual definition's group (mdef_group) and the definitions it files (mdef_defs) are in Translations; they are filed in order, each checked as a definition is.
mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ': filing the definitions ds in order in Ξ, each checked at its type as run_cmd_def does, gives Ξ'.
Inductive mdefs_run (Θ : gdeps) (b pv : bool) : list (string * typ * exp) -> gstack -> gstack -> Prop :=
No definition left
| mdefs_nil : forall Ξ, mdefs_run Θ b pv nil Ξ Ξ
The next definition, checked and filed, then the rest. Its type is a Π into a type of a universe (mdef_defs), so it is relevant.
| mdefs_cons : forall x A M (i : nat) ds Ξ Ξ',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A ->
    gs_fresh x Ξ ->
    mdefs_run Θ b pv ds (gs_add x (gs_def b pv ak_relevant Ξ A M) Ξ) Ξ' ->
    mdefs_run Θ b pv ((x, A, M) :: ds) Ξ Ξ'.

Merging Filed Units

A loaded unit runs from nothing, so what its run filed is merged into the importer's units: the ones not filed yet are added on top, in their order. A path filed on both sides was loaded by two runs of the same file, so it is the same unit (canon_agree).

Definition gds_mem (fp : path) (Θ : gdeps) : bool :=
  match gds_lookup Θ fp with Some _ => true | None => false end.

Definition gds_merge (Θ Θ' : gdeps) : gdeps :=
  filter (fun e => negb (gds_mem (fst e) Θ)) Θ' ++ Θ.

Definition gds_agree (Θ Θ' : gdeps) : Prop :=
  forall fp U U', gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U -> gds_lookup Θ' fp = Some U' -> U = U'.

The Records of Filed Units

The record of builtin bindings each filed unit ended with, apart from the units themselves: merged as they are (builtins_map_merge).

Definition builtins_map : Set := list (path * builtins).

Fixpoint builtins_map_lookup (Rb : builtins_map) (fp : path) : option builtins :=
  match Rb with
  | nil => None
  | (fq, B) :: Rb' => if path_beq fp fq then Some B else builtins_map_lookup Rb' fp
  end.

Definition builtins_map_mem (fp : path) (Rb : builtins_map) : bool :=
  match builtins_map_lookup Rb fp with Some _ => true | None => false end.

Definition builtins_map_merge (Rb Rb' : builtins_map) : builtins_map :=
  filter (fun e => negb (builtins_map_mem (fst e) Rb)) Rb' ++ Rb.

Lemma builtins_map_lookup_merge : forall Rb Rb' fp,
    builtins_map_lookup (builtins_map_merge Rb Rb') fp = match builtins_map_lookup Rb fp with Some B => Some B | None => builtins_map_lookup Rb' fp end.
Proof.
  intros Rb Rb' fp; unfold builtins_map_merge; induction Rb' as [| [fq V] Rb' IH]; cbn [filter List.app].
  - destruct (builtins_map_lookup Rb fp); reflexivity.
  - unfold builtins_map_mem at 1; cbn [fst]; destruct (builtins_map_lookup Rb fq) eqn:Hq; cbn [negb]; rewrite ?IH.
    + cbn [builtins_map_lookup]; destruct (builtins_map_lookup Rb fp) eqn:Hp; [ reflexivity |].
      destruct (path_beq fp fq) eqn:Hb; [ apply path_beq_true in Hb; congruence | reflexivity ].
    + cbn [builtins_map_lookup List.app]; rewrite IH.
      destruct (path_beq fp fq) eqn:Hb; [| reflexivity ].
      apply path_beq_true in Hb; subst; rewrite Hq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Record Declarations

A record is filed as one entry (ge_record): its declaration, with the parameters of the frames as its outermost parameters, and the body of its module, an ordinary module over the record's parameters and then a value of it. The body starts with the record's fields, one generated definition each, the field's projection of the value, followed by the entries of the with-area's commands, run in the record's frame as the commands of a module body are.
The record declared over the frames' parameters with its own parameters Δ, its sort S and its fields fs, all as written over Δ and the frames' parameters, each field at the kind the command carries for it (the fill writes it, from the sort its type infers): a field whose type is a proposition is ak_propositional.
Definition record_at (Ξ : gstack) (Δ : ctx) (S : typ) (fs : list (string * abs_kind * typ)) : record_decl :=
  mk_record_decl (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) S (List.map (fun f => (fst (fst f), snd f)) fs) (List.map (fun f => snd (fst f)) fs).

The type of the field k, of type T over the fields before it and the parameters, in the record's module: at the module's parameters and the projections of its value at the fields before it, as wf_proj types the projection.
Definition record_field_ty (R : record_decl) (k : nat) (T : typ) : typ :=
  T[sb_of_list Id (vars_from 1 (List.length (record_params R)) ++ record_pre R k (a_var 0))].

The field definitions of the fields fs of R from the field k on: each the field's projection of the module's value, at its type, of the field's kind.
Fixpoint record_fields_cmds (R : record_decl) (k : nat) (fs : list (string * typ)) : list core_cmd :=
  match fs with
  | nil => nil
  | (f, T) :: fs' =>
      core_cmd_def f true false (record_field_kind R k) (record_field_ty R k T) (Some (a_proj f (a_var 0))) :: record_fields_cmds R (S k) fs'
  end.

The field definitions of the record R, the first entries of its module.
Definition record_field_cmds (R : record_decl) : list core_cmd := record_fields_cmds R 0 (record_fields R).

Privacy

Every command checks the terms it introduces for access to private members (acc_ok, in Privacy); typing does not.

Section Semantics.
File IO: the contents of the unit at a path, if there is one.
  Variable load_path : path -> option string.
Lexing and parsing. The lexer is OCaml, so this is a parameter too.
  Variable read : string -> option Cst.prog.
Elaboration into core commands, which needs no filed unit.
  Variable to_core : Cst.prog -> option surface_compilation_unit.

Running

Θ ⍮ Ξ ⊢[ch] c ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ': ch is the chain of units being loaded, the one running c first. Only run_cmd_load changes Θ; the premises of run_cmd_def, run_cmd_axiom, run_cmd_mod_open and run_cmd_alias are those of wf_gentry_def, wf_gmod_nil and wf_gentry_alias, with the freshness of wf_gmod_ext; run_cmd_close_mod and run_cmd_close_record file the frame on top as wf_gentry_mod and wf_gentry_record_body check it. A command as written is checked for privacy and filled by run_cmds_written; a core one runs as it is (run_cmds_core).
B is the record of builtin bindings of the unit being run, and Rb the records the filed units ended with, one per unit of Θ: a unit sees the bindings it makes and those of the units it imports, never those of the unit importing it.
Running one command; mutually, a list of them and a unit.
  Inductive run_cmd : list path -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gstack -> core_cmd -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gstack -> Prop :=
  
A definition: its type is a type of the kind κ the command carries — of a large universe, a proposition, or a type of levels when every frame parameter is one (wf_gentry_def) — and its body is checked at it.
  | run_cmd_def : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x b pv κ A M (i : nat),
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort κ Typeω@i ->
      (κ = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters (gs_tele Ξ)) ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_def x b pv κ A (Some M) ⇝ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (gs_def b pv κ Ξ A M) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
An axiom: only its type is checked, a type of the kind κ the command carries, a large universe's or a proposition: a level is never assumed.
  | run_cmd_axiom : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x b pv κ A (i : nat),
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort κ Typeω@i ->
      κ <> ak_level ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_def x b pv κ A None ⇝ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (gs_axiom b pv κ Ξ A) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
A module's frame is opened, at the path x in the frame below and with no member, over its parameters, as wf_gmod_nil checks a frame; its body's commands run in it, and core_cmd_close files it.
  | run_cmd_mod_open : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv Δ l,
      all_assumptions Δ ->
      ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ->
      
the parameters are types of a universe, at a common level
      params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_mod_open x pv Δ ⇝ Θ ⍮ gs_push (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) Δ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
The frame of a module on top, at the path x in the frame below, becomes the member x of that frame, as it is.
  | run_cmd_close_mod : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv mp U,
      mp = qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ (mp, fk_module, U) :: Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_close x pv ⇝ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (ge_body pv (gu_params U) (gu_mod U)) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
The frame of the module of a record type on top, at the path x in the frame below: the record is filed there with the body of the frame, as run_ind_members_cons files a member of a group.
  | run_cmd_close_record : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv mp R U,
      mp = ind_qname Ξ x ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ (mp, fk_record R, U) :: Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_close x pv ⇝ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (ge_record pv mp R (gu_mod U)) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
An alias is filed with the frames' parameters it is declared under; it reads no member of a type of levels over a parameter of a universe, read over its full telescope, as wf_gentry_alias checks (levels_abstractable): module N (n : ℕ) where module A ≔ M end, where M has def v : Level, is rejected.
  | run_cmd_alias : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv Δ l E,
      all_assumptions Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
      
the parameters are types of a universe, at a common level
      params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
      levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E ->
      
the target is no module still being defined
      frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_alias x pv Δ E ⇝ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (ge_mod pv (gu_mk (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias E))) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
A unit filed already, by an earlier load: shared, not reloaded; the record it ended with is merged in.
  | run_cmd_load_filed : forall ch B Rb B' Θ Ξ fp U BU,
      gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U ->
      builtins_map_lookup Rb fp = Some BU ->
      builtins_merge B BU = Some B' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_load fp ⇝ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb
  
Not filed: load it, run it from nothing with itself added to the chain, file it on top of what it filed, and merge that in. A unit already in the chain is still being loaded, so loading it is a cycle, and no rule applies. The unit runs from no binding; the record it ends with is merged in, and filed with it.
  | run_cmd_load : forall ch B Rb B' Θ Ξ fp src prg u BU RbU ΘU U,
      gds_lookup Θ fp = None ->
      ~ In fp ch ->
      load_path fp = Some src ->
      read src = Some prg ->
      prog_path prg = fp ->
      to_core prg = Some u ->
      run_unit (fp :: ch) u BU RbU ΘU U ->
      builtins_merge B BU = Some B' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_load fp ⇝ gds_merge Θ ((fp, U) :: ΘU) ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B' ⍮ builtins_map_merge Rb ((fp, BU) :: RbU)
  
An open checks that its target is a module, and declares the definitions and aliases its items generate in this frame.
  | run_cmd_open : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ E its gs Ξ',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
      
the module opened is no module still being defined
      frame_free_target Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) E ->
      open_gens Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) E its gs ->
      gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_open E its ⇝ Θ ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
A group as written, its members of one sort: the arguments of the declared members classified (raw_member_classify); the views, found from the instances met (views_dfs), each with its siblings, its constructors classified and its non-uniform parameters filed (view_nparams); the group filed (raw_decl_filed) and checked at its views' instances read back (ind_nil_at, grp_self_insts); the names it generates left free (gen_names_free); the declared members, each with its module (run_ind_members); then, for a group declared by mutual T where, its recursor module (rec_cmds), run as core commands.
  | run_cmd_ind_case : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R Mr0 Mrs csD Vs Ss csV Nvs D B' Rb' Θ' Ξ' B'' Rb'' Θ'' Ξ'',
      raw_decl_members R = Mr0 :: Mrs ->
      Forall (fun Mr => raw_member_sort Mr = raw_member_sort Mr0) Mrs ->
      Forall2 (raw_member_classify Θ Ξ R) (raw_decl_members R) csD ->
      Forall2 (view_siblings Θ Ξ R) Vs Ss ->
      Forall2 (view_classify Θ Ξ R) Vs csV ->
      Forall2 (view_nparams Θ Ξ R) Vs Nvs ->
      views_dfs (siblings_table Vs Ss) (meets_table Vs csV) nil (List.concat (List.map classified_cons_views csD)) Vs ->
      raw_decl_filed Θ Ξ R Vs Ss csD csV Nvs = Some D ->
      ind_nil_at Θ Ξ (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr0)) D (grp_self_insts (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr0)) D) ->
      gen_names_free Ξ R D ->
      run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr0)) D 0 (List.map raw_member_name (raw_decl_members R)) B' Rb' Θ' Ξ' ->
      Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' ⊢[ch] List.map ci_core (rec_cmds Θ' Ξ' R (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr0)) D) ⇝* Θ'' ⍮ Ξ'' ⍮ B'' ⍮ Rb'' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_inductive pv R ⇝ Θ'' ⍮ Ξ'' ⍮ B'' ⍮ Rb''
  
A mutual definition: the group, its uniform parameters and each function's member (mdef_group), and the definitions filed in order, each checked as a definition is.
  | run_cmd_mdef : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ b pv Δ f0 fs pq m0 Ps D Us ms Ξ',
      all_assumptions Δ ->
      ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ->
      mdef_group Θ Ξ Δ (raw_fun_head_of f0) (List.map raw_fun_head_of fs) pq m0 Ps D Us ms ->
      mdefs_run Θ b pv (mdef_defs pq D Us Δ (f0 :: fs) ms) Ξ Ξ' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_mdef b pv Δ (f0 :: fs) ⇝ Θ ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
builtin natural := X: X, read as a term, is in normal form the type former of the first member of a group, at no argument, with the shape of the natural numbers, in Type@0; its binding is merged in (builtins_bind_nat), so it is bound unless another type is. X is read through its normal form, so through any alias or definition. Its typing at the inferred type follows from the inference; it is a premise only because the well-formedness of a run is proved before alg_type_infer_sound, in the order of the files.
  | run_cmd_builtin : forall ch B Rb B' Θ Ξ H M W p D z s,
      modexp_as_term H = Some M ->
      @alg_type_infer (gc_mk Θ Ξ) (gs_tele Ξ) W M ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : nf_to_exp W ->
      nf_is_universe W ->
      nbe Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) M (nf_to_exp W) (nf_indty p 0 nil) ->
      ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D ->
      nat_shape D = Some (z, s) ->
      ind_sort D = nat_sort ->
      builtins_bind_nat B p = Some B' ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_builtin nat_kind H ⇝ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb
  
inductive x Δ := H: both parts alias H as written. Read as a term, H has the inferred type W over Δ and the frames' parameters, and is a type former of an inductive type (ind_former); read as a module, it is well formed there. The definition with a module part filed is H as a term over Δ, of type W over Δ, and the alias of H over Δ. The typing of H at W follows from the inference; it is a premise only because the well-formedness of a run is proved before alg_type_infer_sound, in the order of the files.
  | run_cmd_ind_alias : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv Δ l H M W (i : nat),
      all_assumptions Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H ->
      params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
      modexp_as_term H = Some M ->
      @alg_type_infer (gc_mk Θ Ξ) (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) W M ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ nf_to_exp W : Typeω@i ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : nf_to_exp W ->
      ind_former Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) M W ->
      levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) H ->
      frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) H ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_inductive_alias x pv Δ H ⇝
        Θ ⍮ gs_add x (dm_entry Ξ pv Δ (nf_to_exp W) M H) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
record x Δ := H: as inductive x Δ := H, H being a type former of a record type, given any prefix of its parameters (record_former).
  | run_cmd_record_alias : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv Δ l H M W (i : nat),
      all_assumptions Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H ->
      params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
      modexp_as_term H = Some M ->
      @alg_type_infer (gc_mk Θ Ξ) (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) W M ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ nf_to_exp W : Typeω@i ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : nf_to_exp W ->
      record_former Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) M W ->
      levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) H ->
      frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) H ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_record_alias x pv Δ H ⇝
        Θ ⍮ gs_add x (dm_entry Ξ pv Δ (nf_to_exp W) M H) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
A record: checked with an empty module where it is filed (wf_gentry_record); its module's frame is opened over the record's own parameters and then a value of it, and its field definitions run in it at once; its with-area's commands run in it after, and core_cmd_close files it.
