The kinds of the fields are those the command carries, which wf_gentry_record checks.
  | run_cmd_record_open : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x pv Δ Srt fs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1,
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ind_qname Ξ x ⊢ᵉ ge_record pv (ind_qname Ξ x) (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs) ⋄ ->
      Θ ⍮ gs_push_record (ind_qname Ξ x) (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs) Δ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]
        List.map ci_core (record_field_cmds (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs)) ⇝* Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_record_open x pv Δ Srt fs ⇝ Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1
  
An eval changes nothing, but must type-check where it stands, at its type, written or inferred by the fill.
  | run_cmd_eval : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ M A,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] core_cmd_eval M A ⇝ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ ch ] c ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb'" := (run_cmd ch B Rb Θ Ξ c B' Rb' Θ' Ξ')

  with run_cmds : list path -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gstack -> list cmd_item -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gstack -> Prop :=
  | run_cmds_nil : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] nil ⇝* Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb
  
A command as written is checked for privacy, then filled (fill_cmd: its literals from the builtin bindings, its eliminators' groups and uniform parameters from their scrutinees' types, its omitted annotations and sorts from the types its parts infer, its accesses through terms of record types) to the items it runs as, which run before the rest.
  | run_cmds_written : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c its cs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1 B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2,
      acc_ok Θ Ξ (cmd_refs c) ->
      fill_cmd Θ Ξ B c its ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] its ⇝* Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ⊢[ch] cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] ci_written c :: cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2
  
A core command, filled or generated, runs as it is: it is not written, so neither checked for privacy nor filled.
  | run_cmds_core : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c cs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1 B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] c ⇝ Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ⊢[ch] cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch] ci_core c :: cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2
  where "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ ch ] cs ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb'" := (run_cmds ch B Rb Θ Ξ cs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ')

  
run_unit (fp :: ch) u B Rb Θ U: the unit fp, at the head of the chain, runs from nothing filed and no binding. Its leading loads run on the empty stack, then its parameters are checked for privacy, filled (fill_params) and checked against what they filed, then its body runs in its own frame, named fp; Θ is what it filed, Rb their records, U the unit, B its own record.
  with run_unit : list path -> surface_compilation_unit -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gunit -> Prop :=
  | run_unit_intro : forall fp ch B1 Rb1 B2 Rb2 imps P P' l cs Θ1 Θ2 mp K U,
      nil ⍮ nil ⍮ builtins_empty ⍮ nil ⊢[fp :: ch] List.map ci_written imps ⇝* Θ1 ⍮ nil ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      fill_params Θ1 nil B1 P P' ->
      all_assumptions P' ->
      ⊢ Θ1 ⍮ nil ⍮ P' ->
      
the unit's parameters are types of a universe, at a common level
      params_evaluated Θ1 nil nil P' l ->
      acc_ok Θ1 nil (tele_refs nil P) ->
      Θ1 ⍮ gs_push (q_abs fp nil) P' nil ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ⊢[fp :: ch] List.map ci_written cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ (mp, K, U) :: nil ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 ->
      run_unit (fp :: ch) (imps, P, cs) B2 Rb2 Θ2 U

  
run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ': the declared members k, k + 1, … of the group D at pq, declared as R, named xs, in order. Each is checked with an empty module where it is filed, after those before it; its module's frame is opened over the group's own uniform parameters, its generated commands (ind_mod_cmds) run in it as a module body's do, and the member is filed with the body they end with, as run_cmd_close_mod files a module.
  with run_ind_members : list path -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gstack -> bool -> raw_decl -> qname -> ind_decl ->
                         nat -> list string -> builtins -> builtins_map -> gdeps -> gstack -> Prop :=
  
No member left
  | run_ind_members_nil : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k, run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k nil B Rb Θ Ξ
  
The member k, named x: checked with an empty module, its module's commands run in its frame, filed; then the rest
  | run_ind_members_cons : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k x xs M B1 Rb1 Θ1 mp K U B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2,
      ind_member D k = Some M ->
      gs_fresh x Ξ ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ind_qname Ξ x ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv pq k D ⋄ ->
      Θ ⍮ gs_push_ind (ind_qname Ξ x) pq k D (raw_decl_uparams R) Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]
        List.map ci_core (ind_mod_cmds Θ (gs_push_ind (ind_qname Ξ x) pq k D (raw_decl_uparams R) Ξ) R pq D k M) ⇝*
        Θ1 ⍮ (mp, K, U) :: Ξ ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      run_ind_members ch B1 Rb1 Θ1 (gs_add x (ge_ind pv pq k D (gu_mod U)) Ξ) pv R pq D (S k) xs B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2 ->
      run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k (x :: xs) B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2.

The unit given on the command line: run like an imported one, with itself as the whole chain; B is the record it ends with.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record prog_sem (prg : Cst.prog) (B : builtins) (Θ : gdeps) (U : gunit) : Prop := mk_prog_sem
    { prog_sem_unit : surface_compilation_unit
    ; prog_sem_record : builtins_map
    ; prog_sem_core : to_core prg = Some prog_sem_unit
    ; prog_sem_run : run_unit (prog_path prg :: nil) prog_sem_unit B prog_sem_record Θ U }.
End Semantics.

Outside the section, the judgments also name the file IO lp, the lexer and parser rd and the elaborator tc they run with.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ ch ]⟨ lp ⍮ rd ⍮ tc ⟩ c ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb'" :=
  (run_cmd lp rd tc ch B Rb Θ Ξ c B' Rb' Θ' Ξ').
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ ch ]⟨ lp ⍮ rd ⍮ tc ⟩ cs ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb'" :=
  (run_cmds lp rd tc ch B Rb Θ Ξ cs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ').

A Cycle Has No Meaning


Lemma load_acyclic : forall load_path read to_core ch B Rb Θ Ξ fp B' Rb' Θ' Ξ',
    In fp ch ->
    gds_lookup Θ fp = None ->
    ~ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ core_cmd_load fp ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb'.
Proof.
  intros * Hin Hnone Hr; inversion Hr; subst; [ congruence | contradiction ].
Qed.

Running is Deterministic

Every rule is a check, never a choice, and load_path, read and to_core are functions; the chain only decides whether a run succeeds. This is what makes a path filed by two runs the same unit, so the merge loses nothing.

Lemma open_gens_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ H its gs1 gs2, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    open_gens Θ Ξ Γ H its gs1 -> open_gens Θ Ξ Γ H its gs2 -> gs1 = gs2.
Proof.
  intros * Hg [_ _ _ _ H1 _] [_ _ _ _ H2 _].
  destruct (mdenote_functional_all _ _ Hg) as (_ & _ & _ & _ & Hf); exact (Hf _ _ _ _ H1 _ H2).
Qed.

Lemma gens_run_functional : forall Θ Ξ gs Ξ1, gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ1 -> forall Ξ2, gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ2 -> Ξ1 = Ξ2.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [| | | Ξ d pv A M E W i gs Ξ' HW _ _ HE _ _ IH]; intros Ξ2 Hr; inversion Hr; subst; auto.
  (* a definition with a module part: one type inferred *)
  match goal with HW' : alg_type_infer _ ?W' M |- _ =>
    pose proof (functional_alg_type_infer (GC := gc_mk Θ Ξ) (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE)) HW HW') as <- end.
  auto.
Qed.

Lemma Forall2_index : forall {Y} (P : view_key -> Y -> Prop) Vs Ys x v d, Forall2 P Vs Ys -> view_key_pos x Vs = Some v ->
    P x (List.nth v Ys d).
Proof.
  intros * H Hv; apply view_key_pos_in in Hv; revert v Hv; induction H as [| y0 y Vs Ys Hy _ IH]; intros [| v] Hv;
    cbn in Hv; try discriminate; [ injection Hv as <-; exact Hy | apply IH; exact Hv ].
Qed.

Lemma siblings_from_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i ms ss ss',
    siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i ms ss -> siblings_from Θ Ξ Γc qc Cs i ms ss' -> ss = ss'.
Proof.
  intros * H; revert ss'; induction H; intros ss' H'; inversion H'; subst; try congruence; f_equal; auto.
  all: match goal with H1 : im_head ?M = _, H2 : im_head ?M = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2; intros; subst end.
  all: match goal with H1 : ?f _ _ ?qn = Some _, H2 : ?f _ _ ?qn = Some _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
  all: f_equal; f_equal; eapply nbes_functional; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma view_siblings_functional : forall Θ Ξ R x ss ss', view_siblings Θ Ξ R x ss -> view_siblings Θ Ξ R x ss' -> ss = ss'.
Proof.
  intros * H H'; destruct H; inversion H'; subst; [| reflexivity ].
  match goal with H1 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _, H2 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
  eapply siblings_from_functional; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma view_classify_functional : forall Θ Ξ R x cs cs', view_classify Θ Ξ R x cs -> view_classify Θ Ξ R x cs' -> cs = cs'.
Proof.
  intros * H H'; destruct H; inversion H'; subst.
  - match goal with H1 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _, H2 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
    match goal with H1 : ind_member ?D ?k = _, H2 : ind_member ?D ?k = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
    eapply classify_cons_in_functional; eassumption.
  - match goal with H1 : record_lookup _ _ ?qn = _, H2 : record_lookup _ _ ?qn = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
    eapply classify_cons_in_functional; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma nbe_tele_functional : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ Ws Ws', nbe_tele Θ Ξ Γ Δ Ws -> nbe_tele Θ Ξ Γ Δ Ws' -> Ws = Ws'.
Proof.
  intros * H; revert Ws'; induction H as [| κ A Δ W Δ' _ HW _ IH]; intros Ws' H'; inversion H'; subst; [ reflexivity |].
  match goal with HW' : nbe_ty _ _ _ A ?W' |- _ => pose proof (functional_nbe_ty _ _ _ _ HW HW') as <- end.
  f_equal; apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma view_nparams_functional : forall Θ Ξ R x Nv Nv', view_nparams Θ Ξ R x Nv -> view_nparams Θ Ξ R x Nv' -> Nv = Nv'.
Proof.
  intros * H H'; destruct H; inversion H'; subst; [| reflexivity ].
  match goal with H1 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _, H2 : ind_lookup _ _ ?qn = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
  match goal with H1 : ind_member ?D ?k = _, H2 : ind_member ?D ?k = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
  match goal with H1 : nbe_tele _ _ _ _ ?W1, H2 : nbe_tele _ _ _ _ ?W2 |- _ =>
    pose proof (nbe_tele_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H2) as <- end.
  congruence.
Qed.

A group is classified, its views found and it is filed in one way.
Lemma run_cmd_ind_functional : forall Θ Ξ R Mr0 csD Vs Ss csV Nvs D Mr0' csD' Vs' Ss' csV' Nvs' D',
    raw_decl_filed Θ Ξ R Vs Ss csD csV Nvs = Some D ->
    Forall2 (raw_member_classify Θ Ξ R) (raw_decl_members R) csD ->
    Forall2 (view_siblings Θ Ξ R) Vs Ss ->
    Forall2 (view_classify Θ Ξ R) Vs csV ->
    Forall2 (view_nparams Θ Ξ R) Vs Nvs ->
    views_dfs (siblings_table Vs Ss) (meets_table Vs csV) nil (List.concat (List.map classified_cons_views csD)) Vs ->
    raw_decl_filed Θ Ξ R Vs' Ss' csD' csV' Nvs' = Some D' ->
    Forall2 (raw_member_classify Θ Ξ R) (raw_decl_members R) csD' ->
    Forall2 (view_siblings Θ Ξ R) Vs' Ss' ->
    Forall2 (view_classify Θ Ξ R) Vs' csV' ->
    Forall2 (view_nparams Θ Ξ R) Vs' Nvs' ->
    views_dfs (siblings_table Vs' Ss') (meets_table Vs' csV') nil (List.concat (List.map classified_cons_views csD')) Vs' ->
    forall Mrs Mrs', raw_decl_members R = Mr0 :: Mrs -> raw_decl_members R = Mr0' :: Mrs' ->
    Mr0 = Mr0' /\ D = D'.
Proof.
  intros * Hf Hc Hs Hv Hn Hb Hf' Hc' Hs' Hv' Hn' Hb' Mrs Mrs' HM HM'.
  rewrite HM in HM'; injection HM' as <- <-.
  assert (Ecs : csD = csD') by (eapply Forall2_functional; [| exact Hc | exact Hc' ];
                                intros; unfold raw_member_classify in *; eapply classify_cons_in_functional; eassumption).
  subst csD'.
  assert (Agree : forall x, In x Vs -> In x Vs' -> siblings_table Vs Ss x = siblings_table Vs' Ss' x /\ meets_table Vs csV x = meets_table Vs' csV' x).
  { intros x Hx Hx'.
    destruct (view_key_pos_in_some _ _ Hx) as [v Hvi]; destruct (view_key_pos_in_some _ _ Hx') as [v' Hvi'].
    unfold siblings_table, meets_table; rewrite Hvi, Hvi'; split.
    - eapply view_siblings_functional; eapply Forall2_index; eassumption.
    - f_equal; eapply view_classify_functional; eapply Forall2_index; eassumption. }
  pose proof (views_dfs_functional _ _ _ _ _ Hb _ _ _ Hb' Agree (siblings_table_absent _ _) (siblings_table_absent _ _)) as <-.
  assert (ESs : Ss = Ss') by (eapply Forall2_functional; [ exact (view_siblings_functional Θ Ξ R) | exact Hs | exact Hs' ]).
  assert (EcsV : csV = csV') by (eapply Forall2_functional; [ exact (view_classify_functional Θ Ξ R) | exact Hv | exact Hv' ]).
  assert (ENv : Nvs = Nvs') by (eapply Forall2_functional; [ exact (view_nparams_functional Θ Ξ R) | exact Hn | exact Hn' ]).
  subst Ss' csV' Nvs'; rewrite Hf in Hf'; injection Hf' as <-.
  split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma mdefs_run_functional : forall Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ1, mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ1 -> forall Ξ2, mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ2 -> Ξ1 = Ξ2.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [| x A M i ds Ξ Ξ' HA HM Hfr Hrun IH]; intros Ξ2 Hother; inversion Hother; subst; [ reflexivity |].
  auto.
Qed.

Scheme run_cmd_mind := Minimality for run_cmd Sort Prop
with run_cmds_mind := Minimality for run_cmds Sort Prop
with run_unit_mind := Minimality for run_unit Sort Prop
with run_ind_members_mind := Minimality for run_ind_members Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme run_mut_ind from run_cmd_mind, run_cmds_mind, run_unit_mind, run_ind_members_mind.

Whether a core command checks a judgment where it runs: all but a load and a close.
Definition core_cmd_terms (c : core_cmd) : bool :=
  match c with
  | core_cmd_load _ | core_cmd_close _ _ => false
  | _ => true
  end.

Section Determinism.
  Variables (load_path : path -> option string) (read : string -> option Cst.prog)
            (to_core : Cst.prog -> option surface_compilation_unit).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_cmd := (run_cmd load_path read to_core).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_cmds := (run_cmds load_path read to_core).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_unit := (run_unit load_path read to_core).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_ind_members := (run_ind_members load_path read to_core).

A command with terms of its own checks a judgment where it runs, so its global context is well formed.
  Lemma run_cmd_gctx : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c B' Rb' Θ' Ξ',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' -> core_cmd_terms c = true -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.
  Proof.
    intros * H; destruct H; intros Ht; cbn in Ht; try discriminate;
      first [ solve [ auto ]
            | eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_exp_ctx; eassumption
            | eapply ctx_wf_gctx; eassumption
            | eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_ext_eq_ctx; eassumption
            | eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_modexp_eq_ctx; eassumption
            | match goal with Hn : ind_nil_at _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => destruct Hn; eapply ctx_wf_gctx; eassumption end
            | eapply wf_gentry_gctx; eassumption ].
  Qed.

Two fills of a command agree when one of them runs.
  Lemma fill_unique_run : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c its1 its2 B' Rb' Θ' Ξ',
      fill_cmd Θ Ξ B c its1 -> fill_cmd Θ Ξ B c its2 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ its2 ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' -> its1 = its2.
  Proof.
    intros * F1 F2 Hr.
    destruct (surface_cmd_terms c) eqn:Ht.
    - destruct (fill_cmd_head _ _ _ _ _ Ht F2) as (c0 & its' & -> & Hl & Hc).
      inversion Hr as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hr0 _]; subst.
      assert (Ht0 : core_cmd_terms c0 = true)
        by (destruct c0; cbn; try reflexivity; [ exfalso; eapply Hl; reflexivity | exfalso; eapply Hc; reflexivity ]).
      exact (fill_cmd_functional _ _ _ (run_cmd_gctx _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hr0 Ht0) _ _ _ F1 F2).
    - destruct (fill_cmd_no_terms _ _ _ _ _ Ht F1) as (fp & -> & ->).
      destruct (fill_cmd_no_terms _ _ _ _ _ Ht F2) as (fp' & [= <-] & ->); reflexivity.
  Qed.

A unit runs in a frame named by the head of its chain, from no binding, so two runs of it agree when their chains have the same head.
  Theorem run_functional :
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
       forall ch' B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch']⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 ->
         Θ1 = Θ2 /\ Ξ1 = Ξ2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2) /\
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ cs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ cs ⇝* Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
       forall ch' B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch']⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 ->
         Θ1 = Θ2 /\ Ξ1 = Ξ2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2) /\
    (forall ch u B1 Rb1 Θ1 U1, run_unit ch u B1 Rb1 Θ1 U1 ->
       forall ch' B2 Rb2 Θ2 U2, hd nil ch = hd nil ch' -> run_unit ch' u B2 Rb2 Θ2 U2 ->
         Θ1 = Θ2 /\ U1 = U2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2) /\
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1, run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1 ->
       forall ch' B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2, run_ind_members ch' B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2 ->
         Θ1 = Θ2 /\ Ξ1 = Ξ2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2).
  Proof.
    (* the second derivation is the last hypothesis; fills, expansions
       and generations are unique *)
    apply run_mut_ind; intros; lazymatch goal with H2 : _ |- _ => inversion H2; subst end;
      try congruence; try solve [ repeat split; congruence ].
    all: repeat match goal with
      | F1 : fill_cmd ?a ?b ?B ?c ?d1, F2 : fill_cmd ?a ?b ?B ?c ?d2,
        Hr : run_cmds _ _ _ ?a ?b ?d2 _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          assert_fails constr_eq d1 d2;
          pose proof (fill_unique_run _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ F1 F2 Hr); subst d2
      | H1 : open_gens ?a ?b ?G ?E ?is ?g1, H2 : open_gens ?a ?b ?G ?E ?is ?g2,
        HE : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵐ _ ≈ _ |- _ =>
          assert_fails constr_eq g1 g2;
          pose proof (open_gens_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_modexp_eq_ctx HE)) H1 H2); subst g2
      end.
    (* an inductive or a record alias, and a builtin binding: its target
       read as a term is one term, of one inferred type, of one normal
       form *)
    all: try solve [
      repeat match goal with
        | H1 : modexp_as_term ?H = Some ?M1, H2 : modexp_as_term ?H = Some ?M2 |- _ =>
            assert_fails constr_eq M1 M2; rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <-
        end;
      repeat match goal with
        | HT : ?Θ0 ⍮ ?Ξ0 ⍮ ?G ⊢ ?M : _, H1 : alg_type_infer ?G ?W1 ?M, H2 : alg_type_infer ?G ?W2 ?M |- _ =>
            assert_fails constr_eq W1 W2;
            pose proof (functional_alg_type_infer (GC := gc_mk Θ0 Ξ0) (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ (presup_exp_ctx HT)) H1 H2) as <-
        end;
      repeat match goal with
        | H1 : nbe _ _ ?G ?M ?A ?W1, H2 : nbe _ _ ?G ?M ?A ?W2 |- _ =>
            assert_fails constr_eq W1 W2; pose proof (functional_nbe _ _ _ _ _ H1 H2) as E; injection E as <-
        end;
      repeat split; congruence ].
    - (* a load: the same file, hence the same unit *)
      repeat match goal with
        | H1 : ?f ?x = Some ?a, H2 : ?f ?x = Some ?b |- _ =>
            rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <-
        end.
      match goal with
      | IH : forall _ _ _ _ _, _ -> run_unit _ _ _ _ _ _ -> _, H : run_unit ?c _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH c _ _ _ _ eq_refl H) as (-> & -> & -> & ->)
      end; repeat split; congruence.
    - (* an import: its generated commands *)
      match goal with
      | H1 : gens_run _ _ ?gs _, H2 : gens_run _ _ ?gs _ |- _ =>
          rewrite (gens_run_functional _ _ _ _ H1 _ H2)
      end; repeat split; auto.
    - (* a group: its classification, its views and its filing, then its
         recursor module *)
      match goal with
      | Hf : raw_decl_filed _ _ _ ?Vs ?Ss ?cs ?cV ?Nv = Some ?D1,
        Hc : Forall2 (raw_member_classify _ _ _) _ ?cs, Hs : Forall2 (view_siblings _ _ _) ?Vs ?Ss,
        Hv : Forall2 (view_classify _ _ _) ?Vs ?cV, Hn : Forall2 (view_nparams _ _ _) ?Vs ?Nv,
        Hb : views_dfs _ _ _ _ ?Vs, HM : raw_decl_members _ = ?M1 :: _,
        Hf' : raw_decl_filed _ _ _ ?Vs' ?Ss' ?cs' ?cV' ?Nv' = Some ?D2,
        Hc' : Forall2 (raw_member_classify _ _ _) _ ?cs', Hs' : Forall2 (view_siblings _ _ _) ?Vs' ?Ss',
        Hv' : Forall2 (view_classify _ _ _) ?Vs' ?cV', Hn' : Forall2 (view_nparams _ _ _) ?Vs' ?Nv',
        Hb' : views_dfs _ _ _ _ ?Vs', HM' : raw_decl_members _ = ?M2 :: _ |- _ =>
          assert_fails constr_eq D1 D2;
          destruct (run_cmd_ind_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
                      Hf Hc Hs Hv Hn Hb Hf' Hc' Hs' Hv' Hn' Hb' _ _ HM HM') as (<- & <-)
      end.
      match goal with
      | IH : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_ind_members _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ -> _,
        H : run_ind_members _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH _ _ _ _ _ H) as (? & ? & ? & ?); subst
      end.
      match goal with
      | IH : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ -> _, H : run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ H)
      end.
    - (* a mutual definition: the group, each function's member *)
      match goal with
      | H1 : mdef_group _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, H2 : mdef_group _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          assert_fails constr_eq H1 H2;
          destruct (mdef_group_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H2) as (<- & <- & <- & <- & <- & <-)
      end.
      repeat split; auto; eapply mdefs_run_functional; eassumption.
    - (* a record's frame: its field definitions *)
      match goal with
      | IH1 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ (List.map ci_core (record_field_cmds _)) _ _ _ _ -> _,
        H1 : run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ (List.map ci_core (record_field_cmds _)) _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          exact (IH1 _ _ _ _ _ H1)
      end.
    - (* a written command: its items, then the rest from where they end *)
      match goal with
      | IH1 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?c _ _ _ _ -> _, H1 : run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?c _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH1 _ _ _ _ _ H1) as (? & ? & ? & ?); subst
      end.
      match goal with
      | IH2 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ -> _, H2 : run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH2 _ _ _ _ _ H2) as (? & ? & ? & ?); subst
      end.
      repeat split; auto.
    - (* a core command: its run, then the rest from the same state *)
      match goal with
      | IH1 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmd _ _ _ _ _ ?c _ _ _ _ -> _, H1 : run_cmd _ _ _ _ _ ?c _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH1 _ _ _ _ _ H1) as (? & ? & ? & ?); subst
      end.
      match goal with
      | IH2 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ -> _, H2 : run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH2 _ _ _ _ _ H2) as (? & ? & ? & ?); subst
      end.
      repeat split; auto.
    - (* a unit: its loads, then its body from what they filed *)
      cbn [hd] in *; subst.
      match goal with
      | IH1 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ nil nil ?is _ _ _ _ -> _, H1 : run_cmds _ _ _ nil nil ?is _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH1 _ _ _ _ _ H1) as (? & ? & ? & ?); subst
      end.
      repeat match goal with
      | H1 : fill_params ?a ?b ?B ?c ?c1, H2 : fill_params ?a ?b ?B ?c ?c2, HP : ⊢ ?a ⍮ ?b ⍮ _ |- _ =>
          assert_fails constr_eq c1 c2;
          pose proof (fill_params_functional _ _ _ (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HP) _ _ _ H1 H2); subst c2
      end.
      match goal with
      | IH2 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ ?T (gs_push ?mp ?P nil) ?cs _ _ _ _ -> _,
        H2 : run_cmds _ _ _ ?T (gs_push ?mp ?P nil) ?cs _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH2 _ _ _ _ _ H2) as (? & Heq & ? & ?); injection Heq; intros; subst
      end; repeat split; auto.
    - (* a member: its module's commands, then the rest from where they end *)
      match goal with H1 : ind_member ?D ?k = _, H2 : ind_member ?D ?k = _ |- _ => rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
      match goal with
      | IH1 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ -> _, H1 : run_cmds _ _ _ _ _ ?cs _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (IH1 _ _ _ _ _ H1) as (? & Heq & ? & ?); injection Heq as <- <- <-; subst
      end.
      match goal with
      | IH2 : forall _ _ _ _ _, run_ind_members _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ -> _,
        H2 : run_ind_members _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          exact (IH2 _ _ _ _ _ H2)
      end.
  Qed.

  Corollary run_cmd_functional : forall ch ch' B Rb Θ Ξ c B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1 B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch']⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 -> Θ1 = Θ2 /\ Ξ1 = Ξ2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2.
  Proof. intros * H1 H2; exact (proj1 run_functional _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 _ _ _ _ _ H2). Qed.

  Corollary run_cmds_functional : forall ch ch' B Rb Θ Ξ cs B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1 B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ cs ⇝* Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ->
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch']⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ cs ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 -> Θ1 = Θ2 /\ Ξ1 = Ξ2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2.
  Proof. intros * H1 H2; exact (proj1 (proj2 run_functional) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 _ _ _ _ _ H2). Qed.

  Corollary run_unit_functional : forall ch ch' u B1 Rb1 Θ1 U1 B2 Rb2 Θ2 U2,
      hd nil ch = hd nil ch' -> run_unit ch u B1 Rb1 Θ1 U1 -> run_unit ch' u B2 Rb2 Θ2 U2 ->
      Θ1 = Θ2 /\ U1 = U2 /\ B1 = B2 /\ Rb1 = Rb2.
  Proof. intros * Hh H1 H2; exact (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 run_functional)) _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 _ _ _ _ _ Hh H2). Qed.
End Determinism.

Merging Keeps Both Sides


Lemma gds_lookup_merge : forall Θ Θ' fp,
    gds_lookup (gds_merge Θ Θ') fp = match gds_lookup Θ fp with Some U => Some U | None => gds_lookup Θ' fp end.
Proof.
  intros Θ Θ' fp; unfold gds_merge; induction Θ' as [| [fq V] Θ' IH]; cbn [filter List.app].
  - destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp); reflexivity.
  - unfold gds_mem at 1; cbn [fst]; destruct (gds_lookup Θ fq) eqn:Hq; cbn [negb]; rewrite ?IH.
    + cbn [gds_lookup]; destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp) eqn:Hp; [ reflexivity |].
      destruct (path_beq fp fq) eqn:Hb; [ apply path_beq_true in Hb; congruence | reflexivity ].
    + cbn [gds_lookup List.app]; rewrite IH.
      destruct (path_beq fp fq) eqn:Hb; [| reflexivity ].
      apply path_beq_true in Hb; subst; rewrite Hq; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma merge_cons : forall Θ fp U Θ',
    gds_merge Θ ((fp, U) :: Θ') = if gds_mem fp Θ then gds_merge Θ Θ' else (fp, U) :: gds_merge Θ Θ'.
Proof. intros; unfold gds_merge; cbn; destruct (gds_mem fp Θ); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma merge_inv : forall Θ Θ' fp U,
    gds_lookup (gds_merge Θ Θ') fp = Some U ->
    gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U \/ gds_lookup Θ' fp = Some U.
Proof. intros * H; rewrite gds_lookup_merge in H; destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp); auto. Qed.

Lemma merge_none : forall Θ Θ' fp,
    gds_lookup (gds_merge Θ Θ') fp = None <-> gds_lookup Θ fp = None /\ gds_lookup Θ' fp = None.
Proof. intros; rewrite gds_lookup_merge; destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp); intuition discriminate. Qed.

Lemma merge_left : forall Θ Θ', Θ ⊑ gds_merge Θ Θ'.
Proof. intros * fp U HU; rewrite gds_lookup_merge, HU; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma merge_right : forall Θ Θ', gds_agree Θ Θ' -> Θ' ⊑ gds_merge Θ Θ'.
Proof.
  intros * Hag fp U HU; rewrite gds_lookup_merge.
  destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp) eqn:E; [ f_equal; eapply Hag; eassumption | exact HU ].
Qed.

Filing More Units Keeps an Open Stack Well Formed

Each entry of each frame was checked against the units filed when the frame was open; resolution only grows along Θ ⊑ Θ' (gc_sub_deps), so its typing moves along an embedding. A frame names its own unit, which must stay unfiled: that is the only thing Θ' has to grant.

Lemma deps_grow : forall Θ Θ' Ξ,
    Θ ⊑ Θ' -> ⊢ Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅ ->
    (forall Γ, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> ⊢ Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ) /\
    (forall Γ A M, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A) /\
    (forall Γ A M M', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A) /\
    (forall Γ A A', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A') /\
    (forall Γ Ψ Ψ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ') /\
    (forall Γ U U', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U') /\
    (forall Γ H H', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H') /\
    (forall Γ R, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R).
Proof.
  intros * Hs Hb; apply gctx_embedding_preserves_wf; constructor;
    [ eapply ctx_wf_gctx; exact Hb | apply gc_sub_deps; exact Hs ].
Qed.

Lemma frame_fresh_grow : forall Θ Θ' Ξ mp,
    frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp -> gds_lookup Θ' (q_unit mp) = None -> frame_fresh Θ' Ξ mp.
Proof. intros * H Hn; destruct Ξ as [| [mq V] Ξ]; cbn in *; [ split; [ exact Hn | exact (proj2 H) ] | exact H ]. Qed.

An entry checked at its path in the innermost frame keeps the stack well formed.
Lemma add_entry_wf : forall Θ Ξ x E,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x ⊢ᵉ E -> gs_fresh x Ξ ->
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x E Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ HE Hfr.
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] [P Φ1]] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn in Hfr, HE |- *.
  inversion HΞ as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hs0 HΦ Hff]; subst.
  apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact Hs0 | | exact Hff ].
  cbn; econstructor; [ eassumption | exact HE | exact Hfr ].
Qed.

Lemma add_ind_wf : forall Θ Ξ x pv pq k D Φ,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv pq k D Φ -> gs_fresh x Ξ ->
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (ge_ind pv pq k D Φ) Ξ.
Proof. intros; apply add_entry_wf; assumption. Qed.

A member checked with an empty module has its group's own uniform parameters, over the frames', as assumptions of a well-formed context: those its module is opened over.
Lemma ind_nil_entry_uparams : forall Θ Ξ mp pv pq k D Δu,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv pq k D ⋄ -> ind_uparams D = Δu ++ gs_tele Ξ ->
    all_assumptions Δu /\ ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δu ++ gs_tele Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HE Hu.
  assert (Hass : all_assumptions (ind_uparams D) -> all_assumptions Δu) by (rewrite Hu; intros Ha; apply Forall_app in Ha; tauto).
  inversion HE; subst.
  - split; [ auto | rewrite <- Hu; assumption ].
  - split; [ auto | rewrite <- Hu; assumption ].
  - match goal with Hm : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_ind _ _ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ ⋄, Hu' : ind_uparams D = ?Δ' ++ _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hm; subst; rewrite Hu in Hu'; apply app_inv_tail in Hu'; subst Δ' end.
    split; assumption.
Qed.

A record checked with an empty module has its own parameters, over the frames', as assumptions of a well-formed context: those its module is opened over, before its value.
Lemma record_nil_entry_params : forall Θ Ξ mp pv pr Δ Srt fs,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_record pv pr (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs) ⋄ ->
    all_assumptions Δ /\ ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HE.
  assert (HP : record_params (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs) = Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) by reflexivity.
  inversion HE; subst.
  - split.
    + match goal with Ha : all_assumptions (record_params _) |- _ => rewrite HP in Ha; apply Forall_app in Ha; tauto end.
    + match goal with HS : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ record_params _ ⊢ᵤ _ |- _ => rewrite HP in HS; exact (presup_is_univ_ctx HS) end.
  - match goal with Hm : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_record _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ ⋄ |- _ => inversion Hm; subst end.
    match goal with Hp : record_params _ = ?Δ' ++ _, Ha : all_assumptions ?Δ', HC : ⊢ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ ?Δ' ++ _ |- _ =>
      rewrite HP in Hp; apply app_inv_tail in Hp; subst; split; assumption end.
Qed.

The same record's own parameters are types of a universe, at a common level: by the premise of wf_gentry_record, or by (R) of the body of its module, one entry out (the value).
Lemma record_nil_entry_params_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ mp pv pr Δ Srt fs,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_record pv pr (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs) ⋄ ->
    exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l.
Proof.
  intros * HE.
  assert (HP : record_params (record_at Ξ Δ Srt fs) = Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) by reflexivity.
  inversion HE; subst.
  - match goal with Hp : record_params _ = ?Δ' ++ _ |- _ =>
      rewrite HP in Hp; apply app_inv_tail in Hp; subst Δ' end.
    eexists; eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption.
  - match goal with Hm : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_record _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ ⋄ |- _ =>
      destruct (wf_gmod_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ _ Hm) as [l Hl] end.
    cbn [frame_params List.tl] in Hl.
    match goal with Hp : record_params _ = ?Δ' ++ _ |- _ =>
      rewrite HP in Hp; apply app_inv_tail in Hp; subst Δ' end.
    exists l; exact Hl.
Qed.

A later declared member of a group whose first member's entry is in the innermost frame is well formed with an empty module, where it is declared.
Lemma later_member_entry : forall Θ mq Kq Δ Φ Ξ0 y0 pv0 Φm D k Mk x pv Δu l,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0 ->
    gm_entry Φ (y0 :: nil) = Some (ge_ind pv0 (qname_in mq y0) 0 D Φm) ->
    ind_member D k = Some Mk -> 0 < k -> k < ind_ndecl D -> im_head Mk = mh_decl (qname_in mq x) ->
    ind_uparams D = Δu ++ gs_tele ((mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0) ->
    params_evaluated Θ ((mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0) (gs_tele ((mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0)) Δu l ->
    Θ ⍮ (mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0 ⍮ qname_in mq x ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv (qname_in mq y0) k D ⋄.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ He HMk Hk Hlt Hh Hu HPr.
  assert (Hl : ind_lookup Θ ((mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0) (qname_in mq y0) = Some D).
  { assert (HeE : gc_entry Θ ((mq, Kq, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ0) (qname_in mq y0) = Some (ge_ind pv0 (qname_in mq y0) 0 D Φm))
      by (apply (proj2 (loc_entry _ _ HΞ mq (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ0) Φ ltac:(left; unfold gc_frame; cbn; rewrite qname_strip_refl; reflexivity) _ _));
        exact He).
    rewrite ind_lookup_unfold, (proj2 (gc_entry_ind _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HeE)); reflexivity. }
  destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ ⋅ _ _ (wf_ctx_empty _ _ HΞ) Hl) as [HD _].
  destruct (decl_typed_uparams _ _ _ HD) as [HU Hass].
  destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _ HPr) as (ps & Hps & HT).
  eapply wf_gentry_ind_mem_nil with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps); eassumption.
Qed.

A member of a group well formed with an empty module where it is declared has relevant uniform parameters of its own, over the frames' parameters: by the premise of its rule, or by (R) of its module.
Lemma ind_empty_entry_params_evaluated : forall Θ Ξ mp pv pq k D Δu,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_ind pv pq k D ⋄ -> ind_uparams D = Δu ++ gs_tele Ξ ->
    exists l, params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δu l.
Proof.
  intros * HE; revert Δu; inversion HE; subst; intros Δu' Hu.
  all: match goal with HU : ind_uparams ?D0 = ?Δ0 ++ gs_tele _ |- _ =>
         assert_fails constr_eq Δ0 Δu'; rewrite Hu in HU; apply app_inv_tail in HU; subst Δ0 end.
  all: try solve [ eexists; eassumption | eexists; eapply params_evaluated_of_sorts; eassumption ].
  match goal with HΦ : _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ fk_ind _ _ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵍᵐ _ |- _ =>
    destruct (wf_gmod_params_evaluated _ _ _ _ _ _ HΦ) as [l Hl]; exists l; exact Hl end.
Qed.

The name of an entry of a frame is fresh in the body before it.
Lemma wf_gstack_ext_fresh : forall Θ mq Kq Δ Φ0 y E Ξ0,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mq, Kq, gu_body Δ (Φ0 ⊳ y ↦ E)) :: Ξ0 -> gm_fresh y Φ0.
Proof.
  intros * Hg; destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg) as (_ & HU & _).
  pose proof (wf_gunit_mod _ _ _ _ _ HU) as HΦ; cbn in HΦ; inversion HΦ; subst; assumption.
Qed.

Section GrowDeps.
  Variables (Θ Θ' : gdeps).
  Hypothesis Hsub : Θ ⊑ Θ'.

  Lemma global_deps_grow :
    (forall Θ0 Ξ mp E, Θ0 ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E -> Θ0 = Θ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ Ξ ->
       gds_lookup Θ' (q_unit mp) = None -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ E) /\
    (forall Θ0 Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ0 ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> Θ0 = Θ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ Ξ ->
       gds_lookup Θ' (q_unit mp) = None -> Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ).
  Proof.
    apply global_wf_mut_ind; intros; subst.
    all: try assert (Hb : ⊢ Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ ⋅) by (constructor; assumption).
    all: try pose proof (deps_grow _ _ _ Hsub Hb) as (Hc & He & Hq & Hst & Hx & _ & Hm & Hnl).
    all: try assert (Hem : gctx_embedding Θ Ξ Θ' Ξ) by (constructor; [ assumption | apply gc_sub_deps; exact Hsub ]).
    - (* a definition or an axiom *)
      econstructor; try eassumption; intros; apply He; eauto.
    - econstructor; auto.
    - (* an alias: what its target denotes, with no member of a type of
         levels, moves unchanged *)
      assert (Hg0 : ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ) by (eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_ext_eq_ctx; eassumption).
      econstructor; try eassumption; intros;
        first [ apply Hx; eauto | apply Hm; eauto | apply He; eauto | apply Hnl; eauto
              | eapply gctx_embedding_mdenote_no_level; eauto
              | eapply frame_free_embedding; [ exact Hg0 | exact Hem | eassumption ] ].
    - (* a group, before the members of its first member's module: a
         container found at Θ' is the one found at Θ *)
      assert (Hs : gc_sub Θ Ξ Θ' Ξ) by (apply gc_sub_deps; exact Hsub).
      match goal with |- _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ᵉ ge_ind _ _ _ ?D0 _ => assert (HD : decl_typed Θ Ξ D0) by build_decl_typed end.
      pose proof (decl_typed_container _ _ _ _ _ Hs HD) as Hcont.
      pose proof (rview_record_gc_sub _ _ _ _ _ Hs (decl_typed_record_struct _ _ _ HD)) as Hrcont.
      econstructor; try eassumption;
        [ .. | exact (view_maps_coherent_gc_sub _ _ _ _ _ Hcont (decl_typed_view_maps_coherent _ _ _ HD)) | ].
      (* the containers and the records found at Θ' are those found at
         Θ *)
      all: intros;
        repeat match goal with
        | Hk : ind_member ?D0 ?k = Some ?Mk, Hh : im_head ?Mk = mh_view ?qc _ _ _, Hl : ind_lookup _ _ ?qc = Some _ |- _ =>
            apply (Hcont _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh) in Hl
        | Hk : ind_member ?D0 ?k = Some ?Mk, Hh : im_head ?Mk = mh_record ?qr _ _, Hl : record_lookup Θ' _ ?qr = Some _ |- _ =>
            apply (Hrcont _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh) in Hl
        end.
      all: try solve [ eapply rview_struct_gc_sub; [ exact Hs | eassumption ] ].
      all: try solve [ first [ apply Hc | apply He | apply Hq | apply Hst | apply Hx ]; eauto ].
      all: try solve [ match goal with Hp : _ |- _ => eapply Hp; eassumption end ].
      (* the rank, at the containers found at Θ' *)
      all: try solve [ match goal with
        | Hrk : exists rk, view_rank_ok _ _ ?D0 rk |- exists rk, view_rank_ok _ _ ?D0 rk =>
            destruct Hrk as [rk [Hr0 Hr1 Hr2]]; exists rk; constructor; [ exact Hr0 | | exact Hr2 ];
            intros * Hk Hh Hl; pose proof (Hcont _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh Hl); intros; eapply Hr1; eassumption
        end ].
      (* the views' members, at the containers found at Θ' *)
      all: try solve [ match goal with
        | Hvw : forall k Mk qc k' Is vm, ind_member ?D0 k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm ->
                  exists D', ind_lookup _ _ qc = Some D' /\ view_wrap_ok ?D0 D' vm,
          Hk : ind_member ?D0 _ = Some _, Hh : im_head _ = mh_view _ _ _ _ |- exists D', _ /\ view_wrap_ok _ _ _ =>
            destruct (Hvw _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh) as (D' & Hl & Hw);
            exists D'; split; [ exact (ind_lookup_gc_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hl) | exact Hw ]
        end ].
      (* the container of a view *)
      match goal with
      | Hv : forall k Mk qc k' Is vm, ind_member ?D0 k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm -> exists D' Mk', _,
        Hk : ind_member ?D0 _ = Some _, Hh : im_head _ = mh_view _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (Hv _ _ _ _ _ _ Hk Hh) as (D' & Mk' & Hl & Hrest);
          exists D', Mk'; split; [ exact (ind_lookup_gc_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ Hs Hl) | exact Hrest ]
      end.
    - (* a later declared member of a group *)
      match goal with Hg : ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ ?X |- _ => pose proof (deps_grow _ _ _ Hsub (wf_ctx_empty _ _ Hg)) as (Hc' & He' & _) end.
      eapply wf_gentry_ind_mem_nil; try eassumption;
        first [ apply Hc'; eassumption | eapply ind_lookup_gc_sub; [ apply gc_sub_deps; exact Hsub | eassumption ]
              | intros; apply He'; eauto ].
    - (* a member with the body of its module, an ordinary module *)
      econstructor; [ eassumption | auto ].
    - (* a definition with a module part: its module part as an alias *)
      assert (Hg0 : ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ) by (eapply ctx_wf_gctx, presup_ext_eq_ctx; eassumption).
      eapply wf_gentry_def_mod; try eassumption; intros;
        first [ apply Hx; eauto | apply Hm; eauto | apply He; eauto | apply Hnl; eauto
              | eapply gctx_embedding_mdenote_no_level; eauto
              | eapply frame_free_embedding; [ exact Hg0 | exact Hem | eassumption ] ].
    - (* a record *)
      econstructor; try eassumption.
      all: try solve [ intros; apply He; eauto ].
      all: match goal with Hu : wf_is_univ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
        inversion Hu; subst; [ constructor; apply Hc; assumption | econstructor; apply He; eassumption ] end.
    - (* a record with the body of its module, an ordinary module *)
      econstructor; [ eassumption | auto ].
    - eapply wf_gmod_nil; try eassumption; first [ apply Hc; assumption | intros; apply He; eauto ].
    - (* the module of a member, before its first entry *)
      match goal with Hg : ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ ?X |- _ => pose proof (deps_grow _ _ _ Hsub (wf_ctx_empty _ _ Hg)) as (Hc' & He' & _) end.
      eapply wf_gmod_ind_nil; try eassumption; first [ apply Hc'; assumption | intros; apply He'; eauto | auto ].
    - (* the module of a record, before its first entry *)
      match goal with Hg : ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ ?X |- _ => pose proof (deps_grow _ _ _ Hsub (wf_ctx_empty _ _ Hg)) as (Hc' & He' & _) end.
      eapply wf_gmod_record_nil; try eassumption; first [ apply Hc'; assumption | intros; apply He'; eauto | auto ].
    - match goal with HE : Θ ⍮ _ ⍮ qname_in _ _ ⊢ᵉ _ |- _ => pose proof (wf_gentry_gctx _ _ _ _ HE) as Hg0 end.
      destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ Hg0) as (_ & _ & Hff).
      assert (HΦ : Θ' ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ) by auto.
      econstructor; [ exact HΦ | | assumption ].
      match goal with IH : _ = _ -> ⊢ᵍ _ ⍮ (mp, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ -> _ |- _ => apply IH end;
        [ reflexivity | | assumption ].
      apply wf_gstack_cons; [ assumption | exact HΦ | eapply frame_fresh_grow; eassumption ].
  Qed.

  Lemma gstack_deps_grow : forall Ξ, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ nil ->
      (forall mp K U, In (mp, K, U) Ξ -> gds_lookup Θ' (q_unit mp) = None) -> ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ Ξ.
  Proof.
    induction Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ IH]; intros HΞ HΘ' Hfr; [ exact HΘ' |].
    destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ HΞ) as (HΞ0 & HU & Hff).
    assert (HΞ' : ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ Ξ) by (apply IH; [ assumption | assumption | intros; eapply Hfr; right; eassumption ]).
    pose proof (Hfr mp K U (or_introl eq_refl)) as Hn.
    destruct HU as [Δ Φ -> HΦ].
    apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact HΞ' | | eapply frame_fresh_grow; eassumption ].
    eapply (proj2 global_deps_grow); eauto.
  Qed.

A filed unit, which sees no frame but its own, named by its path: that path must stay unfiled.
  Lemma unit_deps_grow : forall fp U,
      ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ nil -> gds_lookup Θ' fp = None ->
      Θ ⍮ nil ⍮ q_abs fp nil ⍮ fk_module ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> Θ' ⍮ nil ⍮ q_abs fp nil ⍮ fk_module ⊢ᵍᵘ U.
  Proof.
    intros * HΘ' Hn [Δ Φ -> HΦ]; apply wf_gunit_intro.
    eapply (proj2 global_deps_grow); [ eassumption | reflexivity | exact HΘ' | exact Hn ].
  Qed.
End GrowDeps.

Merging Keeps Well-formedness

A unit of the right side was checked against the units below it there, which the merge extends; the sides agree, so the merge has them as they are.

Theorem merge_wf : forall Θ Θ',
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil -> ⊢ᵍ Θ' ⍮ nil -> gds_agree Θ Θ' -> ⊢ᵍ gds_merge Θ Θ' ⍮ nil.
Proof.
  intros Θ Θ' HΘ; induction Θ' as [| [fp U] Θ' IH]; intros HΘ' Hag; [ exact HΘ |].
  destruct (wf_gstack_file_inv _ _ _ HΘ') as (HΘ0 & HU & Hn).
  assert (Hag0 : gds_agree Θ Θ').
  { intros fq V V' H1 H2; apply (Hag fq V V' H1); cbn.
    destruct (path_beq fq fp) eqn:Hb; [ apply path_beq_true in Hb; subst; congruence | exact H2 ]. }
  assert (HM : ⊢ᵍ gds_merge Θ Θ' ⍮ nil) by auto.
  rewrite merge_cons; unfold gds_mem; destruct (gds_lookup Θ fp) eqn:Hf; [ exact HM |].
  assert (HnM : gds_lookup (gds_merge Θ Θ') fp = None) by (apply merge_none; split; assumption).
  apply wf_gstack_file'; [ exact HM | | exact HnM ].
  eapply unit_deps_grow; [ apply merge_right, Hag0 | exact HM | exact HnM | exact HU ].
Qed.

Running Keeps the State Well Formed

The state stays canonical, not only well formed: that is what makes a loaded unit agree with what is filed already, so the merge is well formed. Loading files the derivation of the unit it ran, hence the dependent scheme.

Scheme run_cmd_dind := Induction for run_cmd Sort Prop
with run_cmds_dind := Induction for run_cmds Sort Prop
with run_unit_dind := Induction for run_unit Sort Prop
with run_ind_members_dind := Induction for run_ind_members Sort Prop.
Combined Scheme run_mut_dind from run_cmd_dind, run_cmds_dind, run_unit_dind, run_ind_members_dind.

What a run keeps of a stack: each frame's path, kind and parameters.
Definition gs_shape (Ξ : gstack) : list (qname * frame_kind * ctx) := map (fun f => (fst f, gu_params (snd f))) Ξ.

Lemma gs_add_params : forall x E Ξ, gs_shape (gs_add x E Ξ) = gs_shape Ξ.
Proof. intros ? ? [| [[? ?] ?] ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

The bottom frame of a stack, its path, kind and parameters: the frame of the unit being run, which no step closes (run_bottom).
Definition gs_bottom (Ξ : gstack) : option (qname * frame_kind * ctx) := hd_error (rev (gs_shape Ξ)).

Lemma gs_bottom_shape : forall Ξ Ξ', gs_shape Ξ' = gs_shape Ξ -> gs_bottom Ξ' = gs_bottom Ξ.
Proof. intros * E; unfold gs_bottom; rewrite E; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gs_bottom_add : forall x E Ξ, gs_bottom (gs_add x E Ξ) = gs_bottom Ξ.
Proof. intros; apply gs_bottom_shape, gs_add_params. Qed.

A frame on top of a stack with a frame is not its bottom.
Lemma gs_bottom_cons : forall f Ξ, Ξ <> nil -> gs_bottom (f :: Ξ) = gs_bottom Ξ.
Proof.
  intros f Ξ Hn; unfold gs_bottom; cbn [gs_shape List.map List.rev].
  change (map (fun f => (fst f, gu_params (snd f))) Ξ) with (gs_shape Ξ).
  destruct (rev (gs_shape Ξ)) eqn:E; [| reflexivity ].
  exfalso; apply Hn; destruct Ξ; [ reflexivity |]; cbn in E; apply app_eq_nil in E as [_ E]; discriminate.
Qed.

A name is fresh only in a stack with a frame.
Lemma gs_fresh_nonnil : forall x Ξ, gs_fresh x Ξ -> Ξ <> nil.
Proof. intros x [|] H; [ contradiction | discriminate ]. Qed.

Lemma gs_tele_add : forall x E Ξ, gs_tele (gs_add x E Ξ) = gs_tele Ξ.
Proof. intros ? ? [| [[? ?] ?] ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

A name is fresh in a frame with an entry added iff it is fresh in it and not the entry's.
Lemma gs_fresh_add_inv : forall y x E Ξ, gs_fresh y (gs_add x E Ξ) -> gs_fresh y Ξ /\ y <> x.
Proof.
  intros * H; destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ']; [ contradiction |]; cbn in H |- *.
  destruct U as [Δ [sm Φ | E0]]; cbn in H |- *; unfold gm_fresh in *; cbn [gm_names In] in H |- *;
    split; intros Hy; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Lemma gs_fresh_add : forall y x E Ξ, gs_fresh y Ξ -> y <> x -> gs_fresh y (gs_add x E Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * H Hn; destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ']; [ contradiction |]; cbn in H |- *.
  destruct U as [Δ [sm Φ | E0]]; cbn in H |- *; unfold gm_fresh in *; cbn [gm_names In];
    (intros [Hy | Hy]; [ exact (Hn (eq_sym Hy)) | exact (H Hy) ]).
Qed.

Lemma gs_path_add : forall x E Ξ, gs_path (gs_add x E Ξ) = gs_path Ξ.
Proof. intros ? ? [| [[? ?] ?] ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

A filed group's uniform parameters are its own, over the frames'.
Lemma raw_decl_filed_uparams : forall Θ Ξ R Vs Ss csD csV Nvs D,
    raw_decl_filed Θ Ξ R Vs Ss csD csV Nvs = Some D -> ind_uparams D = raw_decl_uparams R ++ gs_tele Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * Hf; unfold raw_decl_filed in Hf; destruct (raw_decl_members R) as [| Mr0 ?]; [ discriminate |].
  repeat match type of Hf with context [match ?e with _ => _ end] => destruct e end; try discriminate.
  injection Hf as <-; reflexivity.
Qed.

The declared members of a filed group are its first ones, each named after its raw member (raw_members_filed); the views after them.
Lemma raw_members_filed_heads : forall Ξ n Vs ms css Ms, raw_members_filed Ξ n Vs ms css = Some Ms ->
    List.length Ms = List.length ms /\
    forall i M, List.nth_error Ms i = Some M ->
      exists Mr, List.nth_error ms i = Some Mr /\ im_head M = mh_decl (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr)).
Proof.
  induction ms as [| Mr ms IH]; intros [| cs css] Ms H; cbn in H; try discriminate.
  - injection H as <-; split; [ reflexivity | intros [] ? [=] ].
  - destruct (classified_cons_num n Vs cs) as [cs' |]; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (raw_members_filed Ξ n Vs ms css) as [Ms' |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
    injection H as <-; destruct (IH _ _ E) as [Hl Hh].
    split; [ cbn; rewrite Hl; reflexivity |].
    intros [| i] M HM; cbn in HM; [ injection HM as <-; exists Mr; split; reflexivity | exact (Hh _ _ HM) ].
Qed.

The members a group's views are filed as are not declared ones.
Lemma raw_views_filed_views : forall Θ Ξ σ n Ks xs Vs Ss css Nvs Ms, raw_views_filed Θ Ξ σ n Ks xs Vs Ss css Nvs = Some Ms ->
    forall M, In M Ms -> im_is_decl M = false.
Proof.
  induction xs as [| x xs IH]; intros Vs Ss css Nvs Ms H; cbn in H.
  - injection H as <-; intros M [].
  - destruct (view_key_pos x Vs) as [v |]; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (raw_view_filed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) as [M0 |] eqn:E0; [| discriminate ].
    destruct (raw_views_filed Θ Ξ σ n Ks xs Vs Ss css Nvs) as [Ms' |] eqn:E; [| discriminate ].
    injection H as <-; intros M [<- | HM]; [| exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ E _ HM) ].
    unfold raw_view_filed in E0; destruct x as [qc k Cs | qr Cs];
      repeat match type of E0 with context [match ?e with _ => _ end] => destruct e end; try discriminate;
      injection E0 as <-; reflexivity.
Qed.

Filtering keeps a list all of whose elements pass, and empties one none of whose elements does.
Lemma filter_all_true : forall {X} (f : X -> bool) l, (forall x, In x l -> f x = true) -> List.filter f l = l.
Proof. induction l as [| x l IH]; intros H; cbn; [ reflexivity |]; rewrite (H x (or_introl eq_refl)), IH; auto with datatypes. Qed.

Lemma filter_all_false : forall {X} (f : X -> bool) l, (forall x, In x l -> f x = false) -> List.filter f l = nil.
Proof. induction l as [| x l IH]; intros H; cbn; [ reflexivity |]; rewrite (H x (or_introl eq_refl)), IH; auto with datatypes. Qed.

A filed group declares as many members as are written, each at its position, named after its raw member.
Lemma raw_decl_filed_decl : forall Θ Ξ R Vs Ss csD csV Nvs D, raw_decl_filed Θ Ξ R Vs Ss csD csV Nvs = Some D ->
    ind_ndecl D = List.length (raw_decl_members R) /\
    forall i Mr, List.nth_error (raw_decl_members R) i = Some Mr ->
      exists M, ind_member D i = Some M /\ im_head M = mh_decl (ind_qname Ξ (raw_member_name Mr)).
Proof.
  intros * H; unfold raw_decl_filed in H; destruct (raw_decl_members R) as [| Mr0 Mrs] eqn:HR; [ discriminate |].
  destruct (raw_members_filed _ _ _ _ _) as [Ms |] eqn:E1; [| discriminate ].
  destruct (raw_views_filed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _) as [Mv |] eqn:E2; [| discriminate ].
  injection H as <-; destruct (raw_members_filed_heads _ _ _ _ _ _ E1) as [Hl Hh].
  pose proof (raw_views_filed_views _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E2) as Hv.
  split.
  - unfold ind_ndecl; cbn [ind_members]; rewrite List.filter_app, (filter_all_false _ Mv Hv), List.app_nil_r.
    rewrite filter_all_true; [ exact Hl |].
    intros M HM; destruct (List.In_nth_error _ _ HM) as [i Hi].
    destruct (Hh _ _ Hi) as (Mr & _ & Hhd); unfold im_is_decl; rewrite Hhd; reflexivity.
  - intros i Mr Hi.
    assert (Hlt : i < List.length Ms) by (rewrite Hl; apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
    destruct (List.nth_error Ms i) as [M |] eqn:HM; [| apply List.nth_error_None in HM; exfalso; exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_le_trans _ _ _ Hlt HM)) ].
    destruct (Hh _ _ HM) as (Mr' & Hi' & Hhd); rewrite Hi in Hi'; injection Hi' as <-.
    exists M; split; [ unfold ind_member; cbn [ind_members]; rewrite List.nth_error_app1 by exact Hlt; exact HM | exact Hhd ].
Qed.

The frames of a stack belong to units on the chain: the ones being loaded, so none a load files.
Definition stack_in (ch : list path) (Ξ : gstack) : Prop :=
  forall mp K U, In (mp, K, U) Ξ -> In (q_unit mp) ch.

Lemma stack_in_add : forall ch x E Ξ, stack_in ch Ξ -> stack_in ch (gs_add x E Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * H mp K U Hin; destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ]; [ contradiction |].
  destruct Hin as [[= <- <- <-] | Hin]; [ eapply H; left; reflexivity | eapply H; right; exact Hin ].
Qed.

Lemma stack_in_push : forall ch x Δ Ξ,
    stack_in ch Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> stack_in ch (gs_push (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) Δ Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * H Hfr mp K U [[= <- <- <-] | Hin]; [| eapply H; exact Hin ].
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn; eapply H; left; reflexivity.
Qed.

Likewise the frame of the module of a member.
Lemma stack_in_push_ind : forall ch x pq k D Δ Ξ,
    stack_in ch Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> stack_in ch (gs_push_ind (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) pq k D Δ Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * H Hfr mp K U [[= <- <- <-] | Hin]; [| eapply H; exact Hin ].
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn; eapply H; left; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma stack_in_push_record : forall ch x R Δ Ξ,
    stack_in ch Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> stack_in ch (gs_push_record (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) R Δ Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * H Hfr mp K U [[= <- <- <-] | Hin]; [| eapply H; exact Hin ].
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] V] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn; eapply H; left; reflexivity.
Qed.

A definition or an alias, checked against the frame so far, keeps the stack well formed.
Lemma add_def_wf : forall Θ Ξ x b pv r A M (i : nat),
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    (r = ak_level -> level_sorted_parameters (gs_tele Ξ)) -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A -> gs_fresh x Ξ ->
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (gs_def b pv r Ξ A M) Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ HA Hl HM Hfr.
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] [P Φ]] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn in Hfr |- *.
  inversion HΞ as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hs0 HΦ Hff]; subst.
  apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact Hs0 | | exact Hff ].
  cbn; econstructor; [ eassumption | | exact Hfr ].
  unfold gs_def; eapply wf_gentry_def with (oM := Some M);
    [ exact HA | exact Hl | intros ? [= <-]; exact HM | discriminate ].
Qed.

A relevant definition, of a type of a large universe.
Lemma add_relevant_def_wf : forall Θ Ξ x b pv A M (i : nat),
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A -> gs_fresh x Ξ ->
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (gs_def b pv ak_relevant Ξ A M) Ξ.
Proof. intros * HΞ HA HM Hfr; exact (add_def_wf _ _ _ _ _ ak_relevant _ _ i HΞ HA ltac:(discriminate) HM Hfr). Qed.

Lemma add_axiom_wf : forall Θ Ξ x b pv r A (i : nat),
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i -> r <> ak_level -> gs_fresh x Ξ ->
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (gs_axiom b pv r Ξ A) Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ HA Hr Hfr.
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] [P Φ]] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn in Hfr |- *.
  inversion HΞ as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hs0 HΦ Hff]; subst.
  apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact Hs0 | | exact Hff ].
  cbn; econstructor; [ eassumption | | exact Hfr ].
  unfold gs_axiom; eapply wf_gentry_def with (oM := None);
    [ exact HA | intros ->; contradiction | discriminate | intros _; exact Hr ].
Qed.

The level condition of an alias over its full telescope gives the premises on lv of wf_gentry_alias and wf_gentry_def_mod, at some lv: the converse of levels_abstractable_of_flag.
Lemma levels_abstractable_flag : forall Θ Ξ Γ E, levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ Γ E ->
    exists lv Rt, (lv = true -> level_sorted_parameters Γ) /\
      (lv = false -> mdenote Θ Ξ Γ E Rt) /\ (lv = false -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt).
Proof.
  intros * [Hl | (Rt & Hm & Hn)]; rewrite ?app_nil_r in *;
    [ exists true, (mdesc_open nil gm_nil gm_nil) | exists false, Rt ]; repeat split; intros; first [ discriminate | eauto ].
Qed.

Lemma add_alias_wf : forall Θ Ξ x pv Δ E l,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> all_assumptions Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ E ≈ E ->
    params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l -> levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) E ->
    gs_fresh x Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (ge_mod pv (gu_mk (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) (md_alias E))) Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ Htel HΔ HE HP Hlv HFf Hfr.
  destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _ HP) as (ps & Hps & HT).
  destruct (levels_abstractable_flag _ _ _ _ Hlv) as (lv & Rt & Hl1 & Hl2 & Hl3).
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] [P Φ]] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn in Hfr |- *.
  inversion HΞ as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hs0 HΦ Hff]; subst.
  apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact Hs0 | | exact Hff ].
  cbn; econstructor; [ eassumption | eapply wf_gentry_alias; eassumption | exact Hfr ].
Qed.

A definition with a module part, its term typed at a type of a large universe and its module part's target well formed over its relevant parameters, keeps the stack well formed.
Lemma add_dm_wf : forall Θ Ξ x pv Δ A M H (i : nat) l,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> all_assumptions Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ˣ Δ ≈ Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H -> params_evaluated Θ Ξ (gs_tele Ξ) Δ l ->
    levels_abstractable Θ Ξ ⋅ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) H ->
    frame_free_target Θ Ξ (Δ ++ gs_tele Ξ) H ->
    gs_fresh x Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x (dm_entry Ξ pv Δ A M H) Ξ.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ Htel HΔ HA HM HH HPr Hlv HFf Hfr.
  destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _ HPr) as (ps & Hps & HT).
  destruct (levels_abstractable_flag _ _ _ _ Hlv) as (lv & Rt & Hl1 & Hl2 & Hl3).
  pose proof (presup_exp_ctx HM) as HΔT.
  destruct (ctx_pi_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ HΔT HA) as [j HP].
  pose proof (ctx_fn_wf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HΔT HA HM) as HF.
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] [P Φ]] Ξ]; [ contradiction |]; cbn in Hfr |- *.
  inversion HΞ as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? Hs0 HΦ Hff]; subst.
  apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact Hs0 | | exact Hff ].
  cbn; econstructor; [ eassumption | unfold dm_entry; eapply wf_gentry_def_mod with (param_level := l) (param_sorts := ps); eassumption | exact Hfr ].
Qed.

Lemma gens_run_wf : forall Θ Ξ gs Ξ', gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ' -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ'.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros HΞ; [ exact HΞ | apply IHgens_run; eapply add_def_wf; eassumption | |].
  - apply IHgens_run; apply (add_alias_wf _ _ _ _ nil _ 0); try assumption; [ constructor | | apply params_evaluated_nil ].
    constructor; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx H).
  - apply IHgens_run; apply (add_dm_wf _ _ _ _ nil _ _ _ i 0); try assumption; [ constructor | | apply params_evaluated_nil ].
    constructor; exact (presup_exp_ctx H1).
Qed.

Lemma gens_run_shape : forall Θ Ξ gs Ξ', gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ' -> gs_shape Ξ' = gs_shape Ξ.
Proof. induction 1; rewrite ?IHgens_run, ?gs_add_params; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gens_run_tl : forall Θ Ξ gs Ξ', gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ' -> tl Ξ' = tl Ξ /\ List.length Ξ' = List.length Ξ.
Proof.
  assert (Hadd : forall x E Ξ, tl (gs_add x E Ξ) = tl Ξ /\ List.length (gs_add x E Ξ) = List.length Ξ)
    by (intros ? ? [| [[? ?] ?] ?]; split; reflexivity).
  induction 1; [ auto | .. ]; destruct IHgens_run as [Ht Hl]; rewrite Ht, Hl; apply Hadd.
Qed.

Inductive Types Stay Where They Are Declared

An entry added to the innermost frame, and a closed module frame filed as a member of the frame below it, keep every inductive type that could be read before.

Lemma ind_lookup_add : forall Θ Ξ x E p D,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_lookup Θ (gs_add x E Ξ) p = Some D.
Proof.
  intros * HΞ Hfr Hl.
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] U] Ξ0]; [ contradiction |].
  destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ HΞ) as (_ & [P Ψ -> _] & _).
  cbn in Hfr |- *.
  eapply ind_lookup_gc_sub; [ apply gc_sub_grow; exact Hfr | exact Hl ].
Qed.

Lemma gens_run_ind_lookup : forall Θ Ξ gs Ξ', gens_run Θ Ξ gs Ξ' -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    forall p D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ' p = Some D.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros HΞ p0 D0 Hl; [ exact Hl | .. ]; apply IHgens_run; try (apply ind_lookup_add; assumption).
  - eapply add_def_wf; eassumption.
  - apply (add_alias_wf _ _ _ _ nil _ 0); try assumption; [ constructor | | apply params_evaluated_nil ].
    constructor; exact (presup_modexp_eq_ctx H).
  - apply (add_dm_wf _ _ _ _ nil _ _ _ i 0); try assumption; [ constructor | | apply params_evaluated_nil ].
    constructor; exact (presup_exp_ctx H1).
Qed.

The definitions of a mutual definition, filed in order, likewise.
Lemma mdefs_run_wf : forall Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ', mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ' -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ'.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros HΞ; [ exact HΞ |].
  apply IHmdefs_run; eapply add_relevant_def_wf; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma mdefs_run_shape : forall Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ', mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ' -> gs_shape Ξ' = gs_shape Ξ.
Proof. induction 1; rewrite ?IHmdefs_run, ?gs_add_params; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma mdefs_run_tl : forall Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ', mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ' -> tl Ξ' = tl Ξ /\ List.length Ξ' = List.length Ξ.
Proof.
  assert (Hadd : forall x E Ξ, tl (gs_add x E Ξ) = tl Ξ /\ List.length (gs_add x E Ξ) = List.length Ξ)
    by (intros ? ? [| [[? ?] ?] ?]; split; reflexivity).
  induction 1; [ auto | .. ]; destruct IHmdefs_run as [Ht Hl]; rewrite Ht, Hl; apply Hadd.
Qed.

Lemma mdefs_run_ind_lookup : forall Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ', mdefs_run Θ b pv ds Ξ Ξ' -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ ->
    forall p D0, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D0 -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ' p = Some D0.
Proof.
  induction 1; intros HΞ p0 D0 Hl; [ exact Hl |]; apply IHmdefs_run; [ eapply add_relevant_def_wf; eassumption |].
  apply ind_lookup_add; assumption.
Qed.

A frame, of either kind, closed into the member it becomes: what was read in it is read in that member.
Lemma gc_sub_close : forall Θ Ξ x pv K Δ Φ,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> kind_tele (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) K Δ (gs_tele Ξ) ->
    gc_sub Θ ((qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) Θ
      (gs_add x (frame_entry pv (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) K Δ Φ) Ξ).
Proof.
  intros * HΞ Hfr HK.
  destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] U] Ξ0]; [ contradiction |].
  destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ HΞ) as (_ & [P Ψ -> _] & _).
  cbn [gs_path gs_add gu_params gu_mod gs_fresh] in Hfr |- *.
  apply (gc_sub_nested _ _ _ pv); [ apply gc_sub_grow; exact Hfr | | exact HK ].
  exact (contributions_found_frame Θ mq Kq P Ψ x _ Ξ0 _ _ (gc_sub_refl _ _)).
Qed.

Lemma ind_lookup_close : forall Θ Ξ x pv K Δ Φ p D,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> kind_tele (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) K Δ (gs_tele Ξ) ->
    ind_lookup Θ ((qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x, K, gu_body Δ Φ) :: Ξ) p = Some D ->
    ind_lookup Θ (gs_add x (frame_entry pv (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) K Δ Φ) Ξ) p = Some D.
Proof. intros * HΞ Hfr HK Hl; exact (ind_lookup_gc_sub _ _ _ _ _ _ (gc_sub_close _ _ _ pv _ _ Φ HΞ Hfr HK) Hl). Qed.

Read under frames of units not filed: as filed.
Lemma ind_lookup_below : forall Θ Ξ p D,
    (forall mp K U, In (mp, K, U) Ξ -> gds_lookup Θ (q_unit mp) = None) ->
    ind_lookup Θ nil p = Some D -> ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D.
Proof.
  intros * Hfr Hl.
  (* no frame of Ξ is at a path of a filed unit *)
  assert (Hno : forall U ip, gs_find Ξ p = Some (U, ip) -> False).
  { intros U ip Hg; destruct (gs_find_unit _ _ _ _ Hg) as (mp & K & Hin & Hu).
    unfold ind_lookup, ind_lookup_u, ind_mlookup_u, gc_module, gc_module_u in Hl; cbn [gs_find_ind gs_find_tele] in Hl.
    rewrite <- Hu, (Hfr _ _ _ Hin) in Hl; discriminate. }
  unfold ind_lookup, ind_lookup_u, ind_mlookup_u, gc_module, gc_module_u in *; cbn [gs_find_ind gs_find_tele] in Hl.
  destruct (gs_find_ind Ξ p) as [r |] eqn:Hk.
  - exfalso; destruct (gs_find_ind_tele _ _ _ Hk) as (U & T & Hf).
    apply (Hno U nil); rewrite gs_find_tele_find, Hf; reflexivity.
  - destruct (gs_find_tele Ξ p) as [[[U ip] T] |] eqn:Hf; [| exact Hl ].
    exfalso; apply (Hno U ip); rewrite gs_find_tele_find, Hf; reflexivity.
Qed.

A binding well formed at one state is at another that reads every inductive type the first does.
Lemma builtins_wf_mono : forall Θ Ξ Θ' Ξ' B,
    (forall p D, ind_lookup Θ Ξ p = Some D -> ind_lookup Θ' Ξ' p = Some D) ->
    builtins_wf Θ Ξ B -> builtins_wf Θ' Ξ' B.
Proof. intros * Hm Hb p Hp; destruct (Hb p Hp) as [D z s Hl Hs Ho]; exact (mk_nat_binding_ok _ _ _ D z s (Hm _ _ Hl) Hs Ho). Qed.

A record read under no frame is read under frames of units not filed.
Lemma builtins_wf_below : forall Θ Ξ B,
    (forall mp K U, In (mp, K, U) Ξ -> gds_lookup Θ (q_unit mp) = None) ->
    builtins_wf Θ nil B -> builtins_wf Θ Ξ B.
Proof. intros * Hfr; apply builtins_wf_mono; intros; apply ind_lookup_below; assumption. Qed.

The records of filed units, each read where the units are filed.
Definition builtins_map_wf (Θ : gdeps) (Rb : builtins_map) : Prop :=
  forall fp BU, builtins_map_lookup Rb fp = Some BU -> builtins_wf Θ nil BU.

Lemma builtins_map_wf_sub : forall Θ Θ' Rb, Θ ⊑ Θ' -> builtins_map_wf Θ Rb -> builtins_map_wf Θ' Rb.
Proof.
  intros * Hs HR fp BU HB; eapply builtins_wf_mono; [| exact (HR _ _ HB) ].
  intros; eapply ind_lookup_gc_sub; [ apply gc_sub_deps; exact Hs | eassumption ].
Qed.

The group a declared member's entry files, at its path.
Lemma ind_lookup_added : forall Θ Ξ x pv D Φ,
    Ξ <> nil -> ind_lookup Θ (gs_add x (ge_ind pv (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) 0 D Φ) Ξ) (qname_in (gs_path Ξ) x) = Some D.
Proof.
  intros * Hn; destruct Ξ as [| [[mp K] U] Ξ0]; [ contradiction |].
  rewrite ind_lookup_unfold, ind_mlookup_unfold; cbn [gs_add gs_path].
  change (qname_in mp x) with (qname_app mp (x :: nil)).
  cbn [gs_find_ind]; rewrite qname_strip_app.
  rewrite gc_module_frame_here; cbn; rewrite String.eqb_refl; reflexivity.
Qed.

Section WellFormed.
  Variables (load_path : path -> option string) (read : string -> option Cst.prog)
            (to_core : Cst.prog -> option surface_compilation_unit).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_cmd := (run_cmd load_path read to_core).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_cmds := (run_cmds load_path read to_core).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_unit := (run_unit load_path read to_core).
  #[local] Abbreviation run_ind_members := (run_ind_members load_path read to_core).

  Lemma run_chain_fresh :
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c B' Rb' Θ' Ξ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' ->
       forall fq, In fq ch -> gds_lookup Θ fq = None -> gds_lookup Θ' fq = None) /\
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ cs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ cs ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' ->
       forall fq, In fq ch -> gds_lookup Θ fq = None -> gds_lookup Θ' fq = None) /\
    (forall ch u B Rb Θ U, run_unit ch u B Rb Θ U -> forall fq, In fq ch -> gds_lookup Θ fq = None) /\
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ', run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ' ->
       forall fq, In fq ch -> gds_lookup Θ fq = None -> gds_lookup Θ' fq = None).
  Proof.
    apply run_mut_ind; intros; eauto.
    - (* a load files what its unit filed, and the unit, which is not on the chain *)
      destruct (gds_lookup (gds_merge _ _) fq) eqn:Ef; [ exfalso | reflexivity ].
      apply merge_inv in Ef as [Ef | Ef]; [ congruence |].
      cbn in Ef; destruct (path_beq fq fp) eqn:Hb.
      + apply path_beq_true in Hb; subst; contradiction.
      + match goal with IH : forall _, In _ (fp :: ch) -> _ |- _ => rewrite (IH fq ltac:(right; assumption)) in Ef end.
        discriminate.
  Qed.

A run keeps the bottom frame of the stack, its path, kind and parameters: a frame is closed only into the one below it (run_cmd_close_mod, run_cmd_close_record), so the bottom one is never closed, and every other step keeps the frames it does not push.
  Lemma run_bottom :
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ c B' Rb' Θ' Ξ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ c ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' -> gs_bottom Ξ' = gs_bottom Ξ) /\
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ cs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ', Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ cs ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' -> gs_bottom Ξ' = gs_bottom Ξ) /\
    (forall ch u B Rb Θ U, run_unit ch u B Rb Θ U -> True) /\
    (forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ', run_ind_members ch B Rb Θ Ξ pv R pq D k xs B' Rb' Θ' Ξ' ->
       gs_bottom Ξ' = gs_bottom Ξ).
  Proof.
    apply run_mut_ind; intros; try exact I;
      repeat match goal with
        | H : gs_fresh _ ?X |- _ =>
            lazymatch goal with _ : X <> nil |- _ => fail | _ => pose proof (gs_fresh_nonnil _ _ H) end
        end;
      repeat match goal with
        | H : gens_run _ _ _ _ |- _ => pose proof (gs_bottom_shape _ _ (gens_run_shape _ _ _ _ H)); clear H
        | H : mdefs_run _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => pose proof (gs_bottom_shape _ _ (mdefs_run_shape _ _ _ _ _ _ H)); clear H
        end;
      unfold gs_push, gs_push_record, gs_push_ind in *;
      repeat (rewrite gs_bottom_cons in * by assumption);
      rewrite ?gs_bottom_add in *; congruence.
  Qed.

A filed unit is what loading its file yields, and its record in Rb the record that run ends with; Rb records only filed units.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record canon_entry (Rb : builtins_map) (fp : path) (U : gunit) : Prop := mk_canon_entry
    { canon_entry_record : builtins
    ; canon_entry_src : string
    ; canon_entry_prog : Cst.prog
    ; canon_entry_unit : surface_compilation_unit
    ; canon_entry_chain : list path
    ; canon_entry_builtin_records : builtins_map
    ; canon_entry_deps : gdeps
    ; canon_entry_lookup : builtins_map_lookup Rb fp = Some canon_entry_record
    ; canon_entry_load : load_path fp = Some canon_entry_src
    ; canon_entry_read : read canon_entry_src = Some canon_entry_prog
    ; canon_entry_core : to_core canon_entry_prog = Some canon_entry_unit
    ; canon_entry_run : run_unit (fp :: canon_entry_chain) canon_entry_unit canon_entry_record canon_entry_builtin_records canon_entry_deps U }.

  Definition canon (Rb : builtins_map) (Θ : gdeps) : Prop :=
    (forall fp U, gds_lookup Θ fp = Some U -> canon_entry Rb fp U) /\
    (forall fp BU, builtins_map_lookup Rb fp = Some BU -> gds_lookup Θ fp <> None).

  Definition builtins_map_agree (Rb Rb' : builtins_map) : Prop :=
    forall fp B B', builtins_map_lookup Rb fp = Some B -> builtins_map_lookup Rb' fp = Some B' -> B = B'.

Two runs of the same file give the same unit and the same record.
  Lemma canon_agree : forall Rb1 Θ1 Rb2 Θ2, canon Rb1 Θ1 -> canon Rb2 Θ2 -> gds_agree Θ1 Θ2 /\ builtins_map_agree Rb1 Rb2.
  Proof.
    intros * [H1 H1'] [H2 H2'].
    assert (Hrun : forall fp U1 U2, gds_lookup Θ1 fp = Some U1 -> gds_lookup Θ2 fp = Some U2 ->
                     U1 = U2 /\ builtins_map_lookup Rb1 fp = builtins_map_lookup Rb2 fp).
    { intros fp U1 U2 E1 E2.
      destruct (H1 _ _ E1) as [B1 src prg u ch R1 T1 EB1 Hl Hr Ht Hu].
      destruct (H2 _ _ E2) as [B2 src' prg' u' ch' R2 T2 EB2 Hl' Hr' Ht' Hu'].
      rewrite Hl in Hl'; injection Hl' as <-; rewrite Hr in Hr'; injection Hr' as <-;
        rewrite Ht in Ht'; injection Ht' as <-.
      destruct (run_unit_functional load_path read to_core (fp :: ch) (fp :: ch') _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ eq_refl Hu Hu') as (_ & -> & -> & _).
      split; congruence. }
    split.
    - intros fp U1 U2 E1 E2; exact (proj1 (Hrun _ _ _ E1 E2)).
    - intros fp B1 B2 E1 E2.
      destruct (gds_lookup Θ1 fp) as [U1 |] eqn:F1; [| exfalso; exact (H1' _ _ E1 F1) ].
      destruct (gds_lookup Θ2 fp) as [U2 |] eqn:F2; [| exfalso; exact (H2' _ _ E2 F2) ].
      pose proof (proj2 (Hrun _ _ _ F1 F2)) as E; congruence.
  Qed.

  Lemma canon_nil : canon nil nil.
  Proof. split; intros * H; discriminate H. Qed.

  Lemma canon_file : forall ch fp src prg u BU RbU ΘU U,
      load_path fp = Some src -> read src = Some prg -> to_core prg = Some u ->
      run_unit (fp :: ch) u BU RbU ΘU U -> canon RbU ΘU -> canon ((fp, BU) :: RbU) ((fp, U) :: ΘU).
  Proof.
    intros * Hl Hr Ht Hu [Hc Hc']; split.
    - intros fq V HV; cbn in HV; destruct (path_beq fq fp) eqn:Hb.
      + apply path_beq_true in Hb as ->; injection HV as <-.
        apply (mk_canon_entry _ _ _ BU src prg u ch RbU ΘU); [ cbn; rewrite path_beq_refl; reflexivity | assumption .. ].
      + destruct (Hc _ _ HV) as [B0 src0 prg0 u0 ch0 R0 T0 E0 Hl0 Hr0 Ht0 Hu0].
        apply (mk_canon_entry _ _ _ B0 src0 prg0 u0 ch0 R0 T0); [ cbn; rewrite Hb; exact E0 | assumption .. ].
    - intros fq B0 HB; cbn in HB |- *; destruct (path_beq fq fp); [ discriminate | exact (Hc' _ _ HB) ].
  Qed.

  Lemma canon_merge : forall Rb1 Θ1 Rb2 Θ2, canon Rb1 Θ1 -> canon Rb2 Θ2 -> canon (builtins_map_merge Rb1 Rb2) (gds_merge Θ1 Θ2).
  Proof.
    intros * [H1 H1'] [H2 H2']; split.
    - intros fp U HU; rewrite gds_lookup_merge in HU.
      destruct (gds_lookup Θ1 fp) as [U1 |] eqn:E1.
      + injection HU as <-; destruct (H1 _ _ E1) as [B0 src prg u ch R0 T0 EB Hl Hr Ht Hu].
        apply (mk_canon_entry _ _ _ B0 src prg u ch R0 T0); [ rewrite builtins_map_lookup_merge, EB; reflexivity | assumption .. ].
      + destruct (H2 _ _ HU) as [B0 src prg u ch R0 T0 EB Hl Hr Ht Hu].
        apply (mk_canon_entry _ _ _ B0 src prg u ch R0 T0); [| assumption .. ].
        rewrite builtins_map_lookup_merge; destruct (builtins_map_lookup Rb1 fp) eqn:F; [ exfalso; exact (H1' _ _ F E1) | exact EB ].
    - intros fp B0 HB; rewrite builtins_map_lookup_merge in HB; rewrite gds_lookup_merge.
      destruct (builtins_map_lookup Rb1 fp) eqn:F.
      + destruct (gds_lookup Θ1 fp) eqn:E; [ discriminate | exfalso; exact (H1' _ _ F E) ].
      + destruct (gds_lookup Θ1 fp); [ discriminate | exact (H2' _ _ HB) ].
  Qed.

  Lemma stack_in_shape : forall ch Ξ Ξ', gs_shape Ξ' = gs_shape Ξ -> stack_in ch Ξ -> stack_in ch Ξ'.
  Proof.
    intros * Hs H mp K U Hin.
    assert (Hin' : In (mp, K, gu_params U) (gs_shape Ξ')) by (apply (in_map (fun f => (fst f, gu_params (snd f))) _ _ Hin)).
    rewrite Hs in Hin'; apply in_map_iff in Hin' as ([[mq Kq] V] & [= -> -> _] & HV); eapply H; exact HV.
  Qed.

Runs of Generated Commands

The commands a group or a record generates — the definitions of its members' modules (ind_mod_cmds), its recursor module (rec_cmds, ind_recursor_cmds), a record's field definitions (record_field_cmds) — are definitions, and the opening and closing of the frame of a module of definitions: they load nothing and bind nothing, so their run files no unit and keeps the records, it is well formed from where it runs, whatever the loads before checked, and it keeps the frames, the innermost one extended. The stack it runs on embeds into the one it ends with.
A core definition or axiom.
  Definition cmd_is_def (c : core_cmd) : Prop := match c with core_cmd_def _ _ _ _ _ _ => True | _ => False end.

What a run of generated commands keeps.
  Record gen_run (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (B : builtins) (Rb : builtins_map)
      (Θ' : gdeps) (Ξ' : gstack) (B' : builtins) (Rb' : builtins_map) : Prop := mk_gen_run
    {
No unit is filed
      gen_run_deps : Θ' = Θ
      
No binding is made
    ; gen_run_builtins : B' = B
      
No record is merged
    ; gen_run_records : Rb' = Rb
      
The stack it ends with is well formed
    ; gen_run_wf : ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ'
      
The stack it runs on embeds into the one it ends with
    ; gen_run_sub : gc_sub Θ Ξ Θ Ξ'
      
The frames keep their paths, kinds and parameters
    ; gen_run_shape : gs_shape Ξ' = gs_shape Ξ
      
The frames below the innermost one are kept
    ; gen_run_tail : tl Ξ' = tl Ξ }.

  Lemma gen_run_refl : forall Θ Ξ B Rb, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ Ξ B Rb.
  Proof. intros; constructor; first [ reflexivity | assumption | apply gc_sub_refl ]. Qed.

  Lemma gen_run_trans : forall Θ Ξ B Rb Θ1 Ξ1 B1 Rb1 Θ2 Ξ2 B2 Rb2,
      gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ1 Ξ1 B1 Rb1 -> gen_run Θ1 Ξ1 B1 Rb1 Θ2 Ξ2 B2 Rb2 -> gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ2 Ξ2 B2 Rb2.
  Proof.
    intros * [-> -> -> _ Hs1 Hp1 Ht1] [-> -> -> Hw2 Hs2 Hp2 Ht2].
    constructor; [ reflexivity | reflexivity | reflexivity | exact Hw2 | eapply gc_sub_trans; eassumption | congruence | congruence ].
  Qed.

An entry added to the innermost frame embeds the stack.
  Lemma gc_sub_add : forall Θ Ξ x E, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> gc_sub Θ Ξ Θ (gs_add x E Ξ).
  Proof.
    intros * HΞ Hfr; destruct Ξ as [| [[mq Kq] U] Ξ]; [ contradiction |].
    destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ HΞ) as (_ & [P Ψ -> _] & _).
    apply gc_sub_grow; exact Hfr.
  Qed.

  Lemma gs_add_tl : forall x E Ξ, tl (gs_add x E Ξ) = tl Ξ.
  Proof. intros ? ? [| [[? ?] ?] ?]; reflexivity. Qed.

An entry added to the innermost frame, well formed, is a generated run.
  Lemma gen_run_add : forall Θ Ξ B Rb x E, ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gs_fresh x Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ gs_add x E Ξ ->
      gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ (gs_add x E Ξ) B Rb.
  Proof.
    intros * HΞ Hfr Hw; constructor;
      [ reflexivity | reflexivity | reflexivity | exact Hw | apply gc_sub_add; assumption | apply gs_add_params | apply gs_add_tl ].
  Qed.

A run of a list of items is a run of a prefix, then of the rest.
  Lemma run_cmds_app : forall ch l1 l2 B Rb Θ Ξ B2 Rb2 Θ2 Ξ2,
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ l1 ++ l2 ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2 ->
      exists B1 Rb1 Θ1 Ξ1, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ l1 ⇝* Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 /\
        Θ1 ⍮ Ξ1 ⍮ B1 ⍮ Rb1 ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ l2 ⇝* Θ2 ⍮ Ξ2 ⍮ B2 ⍮ Rb2.
  Proof.
    intros ch; induction l1 as [| i l1 IH]; intros * Hr; [ do 4 eexists; split; [ constructor | exact Hr ] |].
    cbn [List.app] in Hr;
      inversion Hr as [| ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hacc Hf Hits Hcs | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hc0 Hcs]; subst;
      destruct (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcs) as (Bm & Rbm & Θm & Ξm & H1 & H2);
      do 4 eexists; (split; [| exact H2 ]); econstructor; eassumption.
  Qed.

A definition or an axiom.
  Lemma def_run_gen : forall ch B Rb Θ Ξ x b pv κ A oM B' Rb' Θ' Ξ',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ core_cmd_def x b pv κ A oM ⇝ Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' ->
      ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ' Ξ' B' Rb'.
  Proof.
    intros * Hr HΞ; inversion Hr; subst; apply gen_run_add; try assumption;
      [ eapply add_def_wf | eapply add_axiom_wf ]; eassumption.
  Qed.

Definitions.
  Lemma defs_run_gen : forall ch cs B Rb Θ Ξ B' Rb' Θ' Ξ',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ List.map ci_core cs ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' ->
      Forall cmd_is_def cs -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ' Ξ' B' Rb'.
  Proof.
    intros ch cs; induction cs as [| c cs IH]; intros * Hr Hd HΞ; cbn [List.map] in Hr;
      [ inversion Hr; subst; apply gen_run_refl; exact HΞ |].
    inversion Hr as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? H1 H2]; subst.
    inversion Hd as [| ? ? Hc Hds]; subst.
    destruct c; try contradiction.
    pose proof (def_run_gen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 HΞ) as G1.
    pose proof G1 as [-> -> -> HΞ1 _ _ _].
    exact (gen_run_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ G1 (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 Hds HΞ1)).
  Qed.

The recursor module of a group: its frame opened, its definitions, its frame closed into the member Rec of the frame below.
  Lemma recursor_mod_run_gen : forall ch Θ0 Ξ0 pq D Δu B Rb Θ Ξ B' Rb' Θ' Ξ',
      Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ B ⍮ Rb ⊢[ch]⟨load_path ⍮ read ⍮ to_core⟩ List.map ci_core (recursor_mod_cmds Θ0 Ξ0 pq D Δu) ⇝* Θ' ⍮ Ξ' ⍮ B' ⍮ Rb' ->
      ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> gen_run Θ Ξ B Rb Θ' Ξ' B' Rb'.
  Proof.
    intros * Hr HΞ; unfold recursor_mod_cmds in Hr; rewrite map_cons, map_app in Hr.
    inversion Hr as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hopen Hrest]; subst.
    inversion Hopen as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? l Htel HΔ HPr Hfr | | | | | | | | | | | | | ]; subst.
    destruct (run_cmds_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hrest) as (Bd & Rbd & Θd & Ξ1 & Hdefs & Hclose).
    destruct (params_evaluated_sorts _ _ _ _ _ HPr) as (ps & Hps & HT).
    match goal with |- gen_run ?T ?X _ _ _ _ _ _ =>
      assert (Hpush : ⊢ᵍ T ⍮ gs_push (qname_in (gs_path X) "Rec") (recursor_tele pq D Δu) X);
      [ destruct X as [| [[mq Kq] Uq] Ξs]; [ contradiction |];
        apply wf_gstack_cons; [ exact HΞ | eapply wf_gmod_nil; eassumption |];
        cbn; exists "Rec"%string; split; [ reflexivity | exact Hfr ] |] end.
    assert (Hd : Forall cmd_is_def (List.map (fun jx => let '(j, Mj, x) := jx in
                    core_cmd_def x true false ak_relevant (recursor_fn_ty pq D j Mj) (Some (recursor_fn pq D j Mj)))
                    (List.combine (List.combine (List.seq 0 (ind_nblk D)) (ind_block_members D)) (recursor_names Θ0 Ξ0 D))))
      by (apply Forall_forall; intros c0 Hin; apply in_map_iff in Hin as ([[j Mj] x0] & <- & _); exact I).
    destruct (defs_run_gen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hdefs Hd Hpush) as [-> -> -> HΞ1 _ Hsh Htl].
    destruct Ξ1 as [| [[mp K] U] Ξt]; [ discriminate |]; cbn in Hsh, Htl; subst Ξt; injection Hsh as -> -> HP.
    inversion Hclose as [| | ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? Hc0 Hnil]; subst.
    inversion Hnil; subst.
    inversion Hc0; subst.
    destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ HΞ1) as (HΞ0 & [P Φ -> HΦ] & _).
    apply gen_run_add; [ exact HΞ | assumption |].
    apply add_entry_wf; [ exact HΞ0 | eapply wf_gentry_mod; exact HΦ | assumption ].
  Qed.

The commands of the module of a declared member.
